description:
Account Executive, DACH, Commercial (Existing Business)

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Commercial Grower team works with the most ambitious and fastest growing companies in the Commercial segment. Our Commercial segment includes businesses typically processing $20M–$50M in annual payment volume. Stripe’s payments and financial infrastructure unlocks new revenue streams and growth opportunities for these businesses. The Commercial Grower team supports our users to increase their domestic presence whilst expanding into new territories and unlocking new revenue streams. This is a role that can be based out of our Dublin or Berlin office or Germany remote. 

What you’ll do

As an Account Executive (Existing Business), you will deepen and expand partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing companies in EMEA by helping them to understand how Stripe’s online commerce infrastructure can make payments a competitive advantage for their businesses.

 

Responsibilities

  • Directly manage and nurture a named account list and develop territory and account plans for winning and expanding business with the Commercial segment.
  • Own the renewal and retention strategy for your territory, proactively identifying and mitigating churn risk.
  • Build and maintain key relationships with C-level executives, while orchestrating the right executive touch points as well.
  • Work with company leaders from multiple functions (e.g., Engineering, Product, and Finance) to lead complex product workshops and financial analyses
  • Orchestrate cross-functional teams including Solutions Architects, Customer Success, and Product Specialists to deliver technical value and drive activation
  • Contribute to shaping our Commercial strategy and building repeatable processes and scaled engagement models.
  • Develop strategies for growing wallet share, driving multi-product adoption, and defending/expanding existing revenue for your named account list.
  • Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process
  • Engage with internal Product and Engineering teams to help drive product and DACH market strategy.

Who you are

You are a top class salesperson and relationship manager capable of engaging in business and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including the CTO, COO, and CFO. You are used to building value in competitive situations and enjoy working on products that require deep product understanding, combined with technical knowledge. A positive attitude and tireless work ethic when encountering blockers to success, whether external or internal. You are naturally curious and analytical and enjoy digging into business models and helping customers quantify their investment decisions.

Minimum requirements

  • Fluent in German
  • 7+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a technical product, with a track record of top performance
  • Experience moving sales processes forward from inception to close by leading complex, multi-party sales in a highly consultative manner, understanding strategies and applying value proposition
  • Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment
  • Great listening skills and ability to quickly become a trusted resource for decision-makers across technology and finance orgs within software companies
  • Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements and cost models
  • Superior verbal and written communication skills
  • Highly curious with a strong interest in technology 

Preferred requirements

  • Prior experience at a growth stage Internet/Software company
  • Experience in fintech/payments is a plus, but not prerequisite

description: Health can’t wait. Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. Disclaimer: We're open to hire Account Executives across our Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes and Biarritz offices. ⭐️ The Account Executive (mid-market) job We’re expanding our Sales team in France and are looking for ‘full-stack’ Sales to engage with prospects and turn them into happy Alan customers. You will join a team that focuses on companies from one of the following segments: Tech & Engineering, Business Services & Media, Retail, Transport, HCR, Learn & Care, Food & Beverage or Metallurgy. You will interact with everyone from HR executives to CEOs. Meet Hakim in this article to learn more about makes the Metallurgy segment so interesting for an Account Executive. Why is our Vertical approach interesting? Market potential: Vast and dynamic markets with significant structural challenges, offering fertile ground for a modern, tech-driven solution like Alan. Team readiness: We've honed our go-to-market strategy over the years, and it's paying off with increasing inbound leads and active field marketing driving strong pipeline momentum. Passionate teams: Our dedicated teams brings deep sector expertise and genuine passion for the clients we serve; every day in the field sharpens our edge and fuels our conviction. Growth opportunity: The addressable market is enormous, offering virtually unlimited opportunities for growth. What will you do with us? You’ll own the entire sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. The average sales cycle is 4-6 months, dealing with companies ranging from 30 to 300 employees, with an average ARR of 150K€. At Alan, Account Executives drive deals and close strategic opportunities with prospects. We sometimes handle some customer relationships to ensure the best possible onboarding. You’ll educate prospects, provide inspiring product demos, and onboard key stakeholders, making the transition from prospect to customer seamless. We expect you to understand and apply the Alan Smart & Soft selling method. This method ensures the prospect experience is an integral part of the overall Alan customer experience—making it pleasant and delightful for everyone. We expect you to be instructive to prospects (Smart), as well as to define the best personalized high-touch strategy that suits best each prospect (Soft). You’ll also help us grow and improve as a company, challenging us to enhance our product(s), methods, and strategy, and getting involved in initiatives to expand our customer base. Meet Fanny Cibot who is Account Executive within the Business Services & Media Crew. ⭐ Is it you we’re looking for? You’ll be a great fit for the Metallurgy Team at Alan if you: Have at least 4 years of experience managing the whole Sales cycle, from prospecting to closing. Prospection is a key part of the role; Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above) and an advanced level in English. Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills; Have empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems; Can influence through persuasion, negotiation, and consensus-building; Have a deep understanding of value drivers in recurring revenue business models; Have a great attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team; Are eager to learn fast and make an impact from day 1; Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range. If you're still wondering whether this could be the best move for you, take a look at this article from Lucie Leflour, our Sales Lead in France. Everything else is a plus. We care about having a diversity of experiences, profiles and backgrounds in our team. 🙌 Perks & Benefits At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). Transport. Generous transit benefit Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture. Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. Important note: we hire people, not roles. description:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

As an SMB Account Executive you will be responsible for owning the full sales cycle for small and medium-sized customers, from opportunity qualification through close and initial onboarding. This role focuses on velocity, disciplined execution. You will generate your own pipeline and will manage the inbound (marketing generated) opportunities. 

Your responsibilities: 

Pipeline & Opportunity Ownership

  • Own the full sales cycle for SMB customers, from qualified opportunity through close.
  • Build and manage a healthy pipeline through self-prospecting.
  • Prioritize opportunities based on fit, urgency, and likelihood to close within defined sales cycles.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity management and forecasting in Salesforce (SFDC).

Customer Discovery & Solution Selling

  • Consult with SMB customers to understand their business objectives, supply chain needs, and operational constraints.
  • Translate customer needs into clear, value-driven Flexport solutions.
  • Demonstrate Flexport’s platform and services through structured discovery calls, remote meetings, and tailored demos.
  • Clearly articulate pricing, value, and next steps to move opportunities forward efficiently.

Closing & Onboarding

  • Lead commercial negotiations and close new business in line with revenue and volume targets.
  • Own customer onboarding and handoff by coordinating with Operations/Account Management.
  • Set clear expectations with customers on scope, timelines, and success criteria.
  • Ensure early customer success by staying engaged during initial execution phases.

Prerequisites:

  • 6+ months experience as an SDR or 12+ months of sales experience in a previous role.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple opportunities concurrently in a structured sales process.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with confidence engaging customers by phone and video.
  • A customer-first mindset with a bias toward execution and accountability.
  • Intellectual curiosity and willingness to learn a complex industry.
  • Fluent in English; additional local language skills preferred depending on region.

What you receive back: 

  • An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a  thriving multinational environment 
  • Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis 
  • Commute expenses: Flexport will cover  home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam
  • Amazing office in the heart of Amsterdam. 
  • 25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment.
  • Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport. 
  • A defined pension contribution scheme
  • Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success.
  • Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members
  • Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child.



Commitment to Equal Opportunity

At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

You will join STARK’s Internal AI & Infrastructure team. Rather than building theoretical tools, we embed into cross-functional teams across Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Corporate functions to ship secure, production-ready AI workflows that streamline operations and empower teams.

YOUR MISSION

As an AI Solutions Engineer, you will bridge the gap between frontier AI capabilities and operational workflows. You will partner with teams—from hardware engineering to C-level executives—to structure processes, rapidly build reliable AI solutions, and upskill colleagues through documentation and coaching.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to identify high-leverage use cases and translate loose requirements into structured workflows.
  • Prioritize high-ROI automations and rapidly ship working v0.1 prototypes to users.
  • Build production-ready AI solutions (agentic workflows, custom skills, MCP connectors, LLM tools) using Gemini Enterprise, Python, and APIs.
  • Establish evaluation standards, test harnesses, and clean data pipelines to ensure tool reliability and usability.
  • Ensure enterprise-grade security, defence data privacy compliance, robust database persistence, and documentation.
  • Coach and upskill colleagues through pair-building, workshops, and Show & Tell sessions.
  • Stay ahead of AI developments, evaluate new models, and represent STARK in local AI communities.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Degree in CS, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience with software architecture, databases, APIs, and Python/TypeScript.
  • 1–2+ years of hands-on experience with modern AI technologies: agentic workflows, MCP connectors, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and evals.
  • Executive presence and ability to work autonomously with stakeholders from shop-floor technicians to C-level leaders.
  • Strong communication skills with a passion for teaching and enabling others.
  • Solid engineering discipline regarding data hygiene, compliance, documentation, and maintainability.
  • Willingness to travel ~1x/month between Munich, Berlin, and international STARK sites.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience as Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Technical Consultant, or Freelance Builder.
  • Experience with Google Cloud / Gemini Enterprise or deploying on-premise open-weight models in secure environments.
  • Fluency in German, making it even easier to run local workshops across our Munich and Berlin offices.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

 

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

 

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

description:
Mission

De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances.

Ce que le modèle voit, la manière dont il retrouve les connaissances, les outils qu’il peut appeler : ces choix vous appartiennent, de même que la mesure de la qualité des réponses. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.

 

Activités et responsabilités

Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. Les Context & Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité sur lesquels vous vous appuyez.

Avec l’AI Product Manager et les experts métier du client, une bonne réponse se définit, puis les résultats s’examinent ensemble. La relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues font partie du quotidien.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des applications et des agents LLM : conception du contexte, appel d’outils, workflows multi-étapes.
  • Concevoir la façon dont les agents exploitent les connaissances : requêtes de retrieval, re-ranking, citations.
  • Construire des jeux et des pipelines d’évaluation : réponses de référence, scoring automatisé, relecture par des experts métier.
  • Suivre la qualité des réponses en production et corriger ce qui se dégrade.
  • Choisir les modèles selon la qualité, le coût et la latence ; faire du fine-tuning ou de la distillation sur un modèle plus petit quand le prompting ne suffit pas.
  • Ajouter des garde-fous contre les mauvaises réponses, les fuites de données et le prompt injection.
  • Traiter des documents avec des LLM : extraction, classification, résumés.

 

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez construit une application ou un agent qui appelle un LLM, et vous savez expliquer ce qui a fonctionné et ce qui a échoué.
  2. Votre code est testé et maintenable.
  3. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.
  4. La qualité des sorties d’IA se mesure chez vous avec des jeux de test et des métriques, et vous savez limiter les hallucinations, le prompt injection et les fuites de données.
  5. Mettre en production une application LLM et la maintenir (déploiement, monitoring, coût, latence) n’a pas de secret pour vous.
  6. Le point de départ, pour vous, est le problème métier plutôt que le modèle ; reconnaître que l’IA n’est pas toujours le bon outil, et l’expliquer à des personnes non techniques, fait partie de votre pratique.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Du fine-tuning ou de la distillation de modèles de langage.
  • Une formation en machine learning ou en statistiques, par exemple en data science.
  • Des frameworks ou des protocoles d’agents, comme MCP.
  • Des entrées multimodales : documents, images, voix.
  • Des outils d’observabilité LLM : tracing, suivi des coûts.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Dans ce métier, la difficulté est moins de faire parler un modèle que de savoir s’il dit juste. L’AI Engineer répond à cette question par la mesure : jeux de test, évaluations, suivi en production, plutôt que par l’impression d’une démonstration réussie.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’approfondit sur les projets : évaluation, conception d’agents, adaptation de modèles, avec l’appui de la communauté AI Engineer. À partir de 2027, l’archétype AI Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (responsabilité en production, bases de la sécurité de l’IA).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.

 

Processus de recrutement

description: This is an Atlantic porfolio company. The opportunity Demand for AI compute is outrunning the infrastructure to deliver it, and the environmental bill is growing with it: more fossil power, more freshwater, more land. New capacity on land also means waiting years for power, sites and permits. We take a different route: we bring compute to the power. Far offshore, the wind blows stronger and steadier than anywhere on land, and no grid will ever reach it. Using it lets AI scale without adding carbon or competing with communities and nature for water and land. We're building fleets of autonomous ships that turn that wind into AI compute at sea. Each ship carries its own wind turbines and computing on board, and navigates on its own across the open ocean, following the strongest and steadiest winds. No mooring, no cables to shore: the fleet goes where the energy is. It's AI infrastructure built from the ground up for the open ocean, from power systems and autonomy to high-density computing, engineered to run in one of the harshest environments on Earth. No grid queue. No freshwater. No land. Zero-carbon compute that scales with the fleet. Firm, low-carbon power at a target cost of ~€50/MWh, one of the biggest costs in running AI compute 70%+ capacity factor: offshore wind that behaves like baseload First demonstrator at sea in late 2027 Founded in 2025 by repeat entrepreneurs and industrial leaders. Backed by major international investors. The mandate You'll work directly with the CEO and the board and own the company's business strategy as we go from first demonstrator to fleet. Our platform opens several paths to value across compute and infrastructure, from capacity to hardware to the services around them. You'll decide which to pursue first, build them into the core of the company, and open new ones as the fleet grows. What you'll own Business model & strategy. Shape the business model and evolve it as we scale: products, markets, pricing and unit economics. Turn a breakthrough technology into a bankable one. Strategic partnerships. Decide which partners and customers we build the company with, from AI labs and cloud providers to chipmakers and sovereign compute programmes, and secure the relationships that shape our first fleet. Capital strategy. Work with the CEO on how the business case underpins project finance and fundraising, and own that story with investors and the board. Product direction. Make sure what we build at sea is shaped by where the market is going, working hand in hand with our marine, power and systems engineers. Ecosystem & alliances. Build the partnerships a new infrastructure class needs: chip and systems vendors, cloud platforms, data center operators, ports and financiers. Category leadership. Be our external voice on summit stages, with policymakers and in the press, and make us the reference for AI infrastructure at sea. The business organisation. Build and lead the team across strategy, partnerships and commercial that takes us from demonstrator to fleet. Who you are You've built businesses in deep tech or infrastructure. You've led strategy, business development or a P&L in AI, cloud, data centers or semiconductors, and shaped large, multi-year partnerships. You've taken frontier technology to market. You've brought new, capital-intensive technology to its first major customers and closed the off-take agreements, capacity reservations or long-term contracts that made it bankable. You build, not just run. You've built something from zero, whether a company, a business line or a market, and you're at your best when the playbook doesn't exist yet. You see the whole board. You move between unit economics, partnerships, financing and long-term strategy in the same afternoon. You know AI infrastructure from the inside. Compute economics, workload constraints, and where the market is heading. Compute and infrastructure are your world. GPUs, data centers, power and the economics that tie them together. You hold your own with engineers and turn technical depth into business strategy. The mission matters to you. A business built on AI infrastructure at sea excites you, and you want your work to help AI grow without costing the planet. You work in English. Fluent English is required; French is a plus. How you operate Ownership. You treat the company's outcomes as your own, well beyond your remit. First principles. You reason from the economics and the physics, not from how the market has always worked. Bold and rigorous. You make big bets and do the work to back them. AI-native. You use modern tools to think, decide and move faster. Mission Brief 

The Chief Quality Inspector is the independent authority responsible for defining how product conformity is verified across manufacturing operations. This role establishes inspection strategies, verification methods, conformity assessment criteria, and competency standards to ensure objective evidence exists that every product meets defined requirements.

The position is driving a quality-at-source culture and a scalable inspection framework capable of supporting company growth. The Chief Quality Inspector ensures inspection activities provide reliable product acceptance decisions and robust evidence of compliance throughout the manufacturing lifecycle.

Your Role in Our Space Mission: 

  • Define and govern the company inspection strategy, acceptance approaches, and verification methodologies.
  • Establish conformity assessment criteria and ensure objective evidence supports all product acceptance decisions.
  • Own inspection governance, standards, procedures, and inspection-related competency frameworks.
  • Lead laboratory functions including material testing, metallography, composite testing, calibration activities, and failure investigations.
  • Support process qualification activities by defining required verification and inspection evidence.
  • Drive implementation of quality-at-source principles across manufacturing operations.
  • Ensure inspection resources, technologies, and capabilities can scale with future production demand.

Location: This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.
Travel: 
Job ID: 1891 

ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking & financial institutions from the “harvest-now, decrypt-later” threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.

The Role: 

We are looking for a Distinguished Leader to provide the overall technical leadership for our post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration programme, part of our quantum-safe product portfolio targeting hardware security module (HSM) and network-appliance applications. As the most senior technical authority of the programme, you will own the end-to-end architecture, from cryptographic algorithm and standards strategy to an FPGA-based product architecture with a clear path to ASIC, and you will set the technical direction across the cryptography, hardware, software and security disciplines involved. This is a rare opportunity to shape a strategic security product line at one of the few companies where quantum-safe security is the core business.

Responsibilities:

You will define the system architecture and microarchitecture of a multi-algorithm PQC accelerator implementing ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA/LMS: hardware/firmware partitioning, throughput and lane sizing derived from real customer traffic models, and a stable core-interface specification that lets cryptographic cores evolve behind a frozen contract. You will own the algorithm and standards strategy (NIST FIPS 203/204/205, CNSA 2.0, FIPS 140-3), drive make/buy and IP-licensing decisions, and shape the security and certification architecture together with our side-channel and compliance specialists. You will set the technical roadmap, arbitrate the hardest cross-domain design decisions, mentor the senior engineers who own each domain, and represent the programme externally with customers, standards bodies, certification laboratories and executive stakeholders.

  • Own the end-to-end architecture and technical roadmap of a PQC hardware-acceleration product line (algorithms, microarchitecture, interfaces, and security/certification strategy) from concept to shipping product
  • Act as the programme’s most senior technical authority: set direction across disciplines, mentor senior engineers, and represent the technology with customers, standards bodies and executives

Requirements:

We are looking for a candidate with a Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Cryptography or a related field and fifteen or more years of experience architecting complex digital security hardware, including deep, hands-on exposure to cryptographic implementation with genuine post-quantum depth. You are a recognised authority in your field, evidenced by shipped market-defining security products, contributions to standards, publications or patents, and you have taken accelerators, secure elements or HSM-class systems from specification to production more than once.

You are equally credible discussing lattice-based cryptography with a cryptographer, timing closure with an FPGA designer, and certification strategy with a FIPS laboratory, and you can defend an architecture in front of a demanding customer or executive committee. You make well-reasoned build/buy/partner decisions under uncertainty and raise the technical bar of everyone around you. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.

  • Recognised architect of cryptographic or security hardware products, with authoritative depth in PQC algorithms and standards (FIPS 203/204/205, CNSA 2.0, FIPS 140-3)
  • Distinguished-level technical leadership: sets direction across domains, mentors senior specialists, and represents the company externally

You thrive on ambiguity and ownership, turning a strategic mandate into an architecture, a plan and a working product. You lead through technical authority and clarity rather than hierarchy, you hold quality and security to an uncompromising standard, and you are motivated by building products that will help define quantum-safe infrastructure for the next decade.

  • A role at one of the fastest growing and most exciting quantum companies in the world
  • A competitive compensation scheme, benefits package, and equity plan designed to reward excellence
  • Flexible work models that let you balance your life, your family, and your career
  • Ongoing training and development to keep your skills sharp and your growth on track
  • A career development plan within the IonQ group’s companies
  • A dynamic, close-knit environment where you collaborate with a global team of experts

You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers.

We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them.

Our Tech Stack

At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. At the Frontend we use React, Typescript, and NodeJs. Our infrastructure runs on GCP, and we are heavy users of Kubernetes. Our Architecture is a distributed architecture made of several "Modular Monoliths". We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development.

 

Your role

In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture.

  • Delivery: Lead your team to scope and plan projects, identifying bottlenecks and improving processes. You will ensure engineering standards are held high and remove impediments to provide a smooth developer experience. 
  • Direction: Create alignment and a sense of urgency through well-crafted strategies and goals. You will direct your team to relate their work to organizational goals and provide a clear sense of purpose.
  • Talent: Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent.
  • Culture: Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture.
  • Craft: Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends.
  • AI-first engineering: Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. You will drive adoption of AI-assisted development and review, define what good practice looks like, and measure the effect on delivery speed and quality. You will keep the team’s standards high while the way of working changes.

 

Your profile

  • 3 years minimum of experience in the field managing a team, focused on building and maintaining complex domains and distributed architectures.
  • Strong recent experience in managing high-performing, diverse, and inclusive teams.
  • Strong knowledge in Distributed Systems and Domain Driven Design.
  • Ability to set technical direction without getting bogged down in heavy hands-on work.
  • Real, recent experience using AI tools in your own day-to-day work and getting your team to do the same. For us AI is central to how we deliver, so if you see it as a nice-to-have, this role is not the right fit.

 

What’s in it for you

  • Unlimited paid holidays, minimum-based not maximum!
  • Position based in our Rotterdam office with hybrid working policy (2 office days).
  • Flexibility to work remotely for up to 2 months per year!
  • 1,000 EUR personal development budget.
  • Complete coverage for commuting.
  • Personal equipment, including laptop and ergonomic setup.
  • Gym membership discount with Wellhub.
  • Dutch/English classes budget.
  • Variable pension scheme.
  • Diverse international community (46+ nationalities).

  • Team-building events and after-work drinks every Friday.

description:
OUR MISSION

At Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes.

 

ABOUT US

Redwood Software is the leading orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise, driving business transformation at the lowest total cost of ownership. Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS-first automation fabric—with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle—Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. Backed by 30 years of experience and trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 50, Redwood helps organizations unlock human potential to focus on innovation, growth and what’s next.

 

 

CORE VALUES

One Team. One Redwood

Make Your Own Weather

Obsess over Customer Success

Work the Problem

Be Curious

Own the Outcome

Respect Each Other

 

YOUR IMPACT

We are a leading SaaS company dedicated to delivering innovative solutions that empower businesses to streamline operations and drive growth. As we continue to expand our footprint in the enterprise sector, we are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Enterprise Account Executive to join our sales team.

The Enterprise Account Executive will be responsible for identifying, developing, and closing new business opportunities with large enterprise clients. This role requires a consultative sales approach, deep understanding of enterprise needs, and the ability to navigate complex sales cycles to deliver tailored SaaS solutions.

  • New Business Development: Identify and prospect potential enterprise clients, targeting key decision-makers in relevant industries. Develop strategies to generate new business opportunities and build a robust sales pipeline.

description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

 

What you’ll do at Jamf:

 

The Enterprise New Logo Account Executive MEA is a results-driven hunter responsible for identifying, pursuing, and closing new enterprise logos for Jamf. Focused exclusively on net-new acquisition within the enterprise segment (organizations with 1,000+ employees), this role requires strong prospecting discipline, the ability to manage complex multi-stakeholder sales cycles, and the consultative acumen to position Jamf's Apple Enterprise Management solutions at the executive level. Success in this role is defined by consistent pipeline generation, new logo attainment, and laying the foundation for long-term customer partnerships.

This role is offered in The Netherlands only, preferably for candidates located in the Randstad and used to travel to MEA #LI-Remote

 

What you can expect to do this role:

 

New Logo Prospecting & Pipeline Development

  • Build and manage a targeted outbound prospecting motion to identify and engage net-new enterprise accounts within an assigned segment or territory.
  • Develop segment fluency — understanding buyer personas, common objections, industry-specific compliance needs, and Apple ecosystem maturity within target accounts.
  • Partner with Marketing, Business Development, and Channel partners to execute coordinated account-based prospecting that feeds a healthy, qualified pipeline.
  • Maintain consistent pipeline coverage and hygiene, ensuring sufficient volume and stage diversity to meet and exceed quota targets.

Enterprise Sales Cycle Management

  • Manage the full sales cycle from initial outreach and discovery through proposal, negotiation, and close — navigating the complexity typical of enterprise buying processes.
  • Identify and engage multiple stakeholders across IT, Security, Finance, Legal, Procurement, and executive leadership to build multi-threaded relationships within target accounts.
  • Apply a structured qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC) to assess deal health, prioritize effort, and improve forecast accuracy.
  • Navigate enterprise procurement processes, including security reviews, DPAs, and SLAs, with support from Jamf Legal and internal stakeholders.
  • Develop and deliver compelling business cases, demonstrations, and ROI presentations tailored to the priorities of diverse buying audiences.

Commercial & Deal Execution

  • Structure initial commercial agreements that are competitive, value-aligned, and appropriately sized to facilitate a strong land — with long-term expansion in mind.
  • Negotiate contract terms with support from Jamf Legal and Finance, maintaining deal momentum while protecting Jamf's commercial interests.
  • Maintain competitive positioning in deals where incumbents or alternatives are present; articulate Jamf's differentiated value with confidence.

Partner & Ecosystem Engagement

  • Build productive working relationships with Apple's enterprise sales team and Jamf's channel and reseller partners to generate introductions and support deal execution.
  • Engage partner resources appropriately to accelerate pipeline and strengthen account access, especially within named accounts or complex organizations.

Forecasting, Reporting & Team Contribution

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in Salesforce, including account activity, pipeline stage, and deal notes, to support individual and team forecasting.
  • Provide consistent, reliable monthly and quarterly forecasts, with clear visibility into deal status and expected close timelines.
  • Share learnings from the field — win/loss patterns, competitive intelligence, objection themes — to contribute to team and segment knowledge.

 

What we are looking for:

 

  • Minimum of 5 years of B2B SaaS or technology sales experience with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding quota (Required)
  • Professional working proficiency in English is required and Arabic is preferred.
  • Experience managing complex enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders, including IT and executive-level buyers (Required)
  • Proven ability to generate pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner engagement, and marketing collaboration (Required)
  • Familiarity with a structured sales qualification methodology (e.g., MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, SPIN) and ability to apply it to assess deal health (Required)
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in both direct and indirect (channel/partner) selling models (Required)
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to deliver clear and persuasive presentations to technical and business audiences (Required)
  • Proficiency with Salesforce or equivalent CRM for pipeline tracking, forecasting, and activity documentation (Required)
  • Consultative, solutions-oriented selling approach with the ability to connect technology to business outcomes (Preferred)
  • Familiarity with Apple enterprise ecosystem, endpoint management, or SaaS security solutions (Preferred)
  • Experience navigating enterprise procurement processes including DPAs, SLAs, and security reviews (Preferred)
  • Self-directed and resilient; able to manage long sales cycles and ambiguous buying processes with discipline and focus (Preferred)
  • Travel in the MEA territory around 40%.

 

SECURITY AND PRIVACY REQUIREMENTS

 

  • Participation in ongoing security training is mandatory.
  • Established security protocols will be adhered to, sensitive data will be handled responsibly, and data protection practices are followed, including understanding relevant privacy regulations and reporting breaches.
  • Acknowledging the Jamf Code of Conduct, where applicable security and privacy policies can be found, is a requirement of all roles at Jamf.

 

Why Jamf?

 

  • Named a Fortune Best Workplace for Millennials, 2021.
  • We offer a clear and defined sales career path. Our main goal is to help you successfully step into our Account Executive role, but there are many ways to advance your career at Jamf.
  • We train and then we give you the room to grow. Our Jamfs can explore the vertical career path, as well as the horizontal, to discover new interests and opportunities.
  • You don’t have to be a techie to be a Jamf. Our best-in-class sales focused Bootcamp training provides you with the technical and product knowledge required to confidently talk with customers about Jamf.
  • We set achievable targets, help each other out, and share best practices across the team.
  • You will have the opportunity to make a real and meaningful impact for more than 70,000 global customers with the best Apple device management solution in the world.
  • We put people over profits – which is why our customers keep coming back to us.
  • We encourage you to simply be you. We constantly seek and value different perspectives to ensure Jamf is a place where everyone feels comfortable and can be successful.
  • 23 of 25 world’s most valuable brands rely on Jamf to do their best work (as ranked by Forbes).

What it means to be a Jamf?
We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.  

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. We are committed to supporting the continual improvement of Apple in the workplace, the organizations that rely on them and the people who keep it all running smoothly.  

Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement. 


What does Jamf do?
Jamf extends the legendary Apple experience people enjoy in their personal lives to the workplace. We believe the experience of using a device at work or school should feel the same, and be as secure as, using a personal device. With Jamf, customers are able to confidently automate Mac, iPad, iPhone and Apple TV deployment, management, and security – anytime, anywhere – to protect the data and applications used by employees in the workplace, students learning in the classroom, and streamline communications in healthcare between patients and providers. More than 2,500 Jamf strong worldwide, we are free-thinkers, can-doers, and problems crushers who are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work each and every day.

Get social with us and follow the conversation at #OneJamf

If you need an accommodation, please contact your Recruiter or Recruiting Coordinator directly. Requests for accommodation will be handled confidentially by Recruiting and will not be shared with the hiring manager. Jamf is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against individuals who request reasonable accommodation for disability or religious beliefs. By joining our high-growth Sales organization, you will work alongside driven, collaborative professionals who are passionate about helping customers reduce cyber risk and protect what matters most. Our team brings curiosity, accountability, and executive-level storytelling to every customer conversation, helping organizations understand their environments, prioritize risk, and take action before attacks become cyber disasters. If you are motivated by meaningful customer impact, continuous growth, and the opportunity to help define the future of breach containment, Illumio is the place to build your next chapter. Your Impact: Serve as an Enterprise Sales Executive in the Illumio field organization, finding and creating new sales opportunities within our target accounts and leading a virtual team of Illumio people and external partners to win those opportunities Create and execute a territory plan on your target accounts and approach to “landing and expanding," and prospect into these target accounts with the goal of engaging potential champions and sponsors to find and create an opportunity Able to drive a regional sales plan that incorporates tight collaboration between ADRs, partner account managers, customer success advisors and extended field team resources Accurately forecast the business objectives of your clients and Illumio Identify, engage, and build relationships with resellers, system integrators and other partners Your Toolkit: 8+ years of full cycle sales enterprise selling with strong background in security and or networking software, including 5+ years of co-selling experience with a strong partner network Deliver compelling “teaching conversations” that are well tailored to each prospect’s situation Able to engage with urgency and capitalizing on all potential channels to sell Illumio Knows how to ask the right questions, strong listener and technically savvy to understand the solution Successful track record of successful selling to the C-suite (all lines of business) with a strong rolodex of contacts in region Experience in a fast-paced company with the ability to adapt as needed #LI-SL1 #LI-REMOTE Our Commitment Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions creates a culture of belonging, drives our future, and makes us stronger together in support of our customers and their success. Join our team in Munich, where you will help keep the software behind our robotics data-collection farm stable. We are seeking a hands-on student or recent graduate who has built and tested a full-stack web application.

Responsibilities

  • Farm Operations: Diagnose failures in stations, releases, secrets, and data downloads, apply a safe fix, and document what happened so the next person does not start from zero.
  • Bug Fixing: Reproduce issues reported from the farm, trace them through the UI, API, and database, fix the root cause, and verify the fix on a running system.
  • Testing: Add unit, API, and UI tests to new and existing features, write a test with every fix that would have caught the issue, and keep the tests reliable inside the regular test suite.
  • Automation: Automate the check or the fix itself when the same kind of issue keeps coming back.
  • Operational Tooling: Build small features and tools that make daily work easier for operators and engineers.
  • Engineering Workflow: Work in small pull requests with clear descriptions and take review from a full-time engineer.

Essential Skills

  • Background: Currently enrolled in, or recently graduated from, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Debugging: Reproduce a vague report such as “this screen is wrong”, trace it to the cause across frontend, backend, and database, and explain what you found.
  • Full-Stack Development: Coursework or personal projects with a React frontend and a Python backend, ideally FastAPI, that talks to a database.
  • Testing: Experience writing unit, API, or UI tests that fail only when the behavior they check is broken.
  • Written Communication: Write bug tickets, pull request descriptions, and incident notes that stand on their own.

Beneficial Skills

  • Deployment Basics: Familiarity with Linux, containers, and reading application logs to find why a deployed service failed.
  • Go: Read Go code and make small, well-scoped changes with guidance.

What we offer

  • A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors.
  • Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment.
  • Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow.
  • Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth.
  • Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month.
  • Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment

About us

Agile Robots is a leading provider of AI-powered robotics solutions. By combining artificial intelligence and robotics, the company makes industries smarter, more flexible, and more efficient. 

Founded in Munich in 2018 by renowned robotics researchers from the German Aerospace Center (DLR), Agile Robots has experienced rapid global growth. Today, more than 3,500 highly skilled robotics and AI enthusiasts are employed worldwide. The company has one of the largest research and development teams in the AI and robotics industry. 

Agile Robots has built a unique portfolio; together with the subsidiaries BÄR Automation, Franka Robotics, idealworks, and Krause Automation, the company covers all areas of AI-driven robotics.

It’s where travellers tell the truth about their journeys, inspire others and help the next person go and experience it. You’ll work closely with Product (Social Connection and Loyalty team), Customer Experience, Legal and Privacy, PR & Partnerships, Social, and our Creator Partnerships and Creative colleagues. You’ll be: Shaping the community vision, values and member code with the Brand Lead, and laying the foundations for Interrail as a cultural movement, online and offline. Building the community strategy: who we bring in first, which journeys launch first and how the community grows after launch. Bringing our existing members across as founding voices, and working with Content and Marketing to onboard our Pioneers. Launching the first community rituals, and making the community a source of real traveller stories for the brand. Designing and running a first pilot of real-world moments, such as gatherings at stations or partner places, with PR & Partnerships and Social. Keeping the community safe: setting guidelines, the moderation approach with Customer Experience, and working with Legal, Privacy, and Safety so nothing goes live until it’s signed off. description: About Scality Scality builds data infrastructure software for enterprise AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign control at multi-petabyte to exabyte scale. Its AI Data Infrastructure platform reduces operational burden through AI-powered autonomous operations while aligning the right storage media, performance, and protection to each workload through human-approved lifecycle policies. Built on CORE5 cyber resilience and open-code principles, Scality software delivers extreme performance, operational simplicity, and sustainable economics. The world's most demanding enterprises and government organizations depend on Scality to power AI initiatives, defend critical data, and build infrastructure that lasts for decades. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality is where AI remembers, learns, and thinks. F Follow us on LinkedIn. Visit www.scality.com and our blog. Context & Motivation A distributed storage cluster continuously emits telemetry at every level, from the platform and S3 service down to each server and disk. A failing disk, server or storage node leaves traces in these multivariate time series, from subtle shifts in a few metrics to system-wide disruption. Detecting and diagnosing these anomalies early is critical for: Predictive maintenance: isolating or replacing a component before it impacts service Faster diagnosis: pointing support engineers to the root cause, not just to an alert Higher availability and durability of customer data This internship is part of a joint research project between Scality and an INRIA research team. The project released SHAD (Scality High-dimensional Anomaly Detection), an open benchmark published at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets Track). It contains 215 real 171-dimensional time series from Scality RING clusters, annotated for injected disk, server and storage-node failures. SHAD's baselines show the problem is far from solved. No detector handles every failure type, per-dimension attributions find root causes no better than chance, and off-the-shelf LLMs cannot interpret the anomalies. This internship builds on SHAD to close these gaps. More details on the project: scality.github.io/shad Your Mission As part of our R&D team and in close collaboration with INRIA researchers, you will develop AI models that detect, explain and interpret anomalies in storage-cluster telemetry. Your work will include: 1. State of the Art Review the literature and open-source projects on multivariate time series anomaly detection, root-cause attribution and LLM-based interpretation of time series. Also survey recent work on AI agents that automate research and experimentation. Starting points include SHAD and the TSB-AD benchmark. 2. Anomaly Detection & Diagnosis Models Design, train and benchmark models that improve on SHAD's baselines at each stage of the pipeline: Detection that stays accurate across disk, server and storage-node failures (e.g., ensembles, hybrid models, time series foundation models) Explanation: attributing each anomaly to the dimensions that actually cause it Interpretation: turning detections into actionable diagnoses (failure type, criticality, affected component) Early detection of progressive degradations, the core of predictive maintenance 3. Fleets of AI Agents for Research Set up and manage fleets of AI agents that run your studies at scale: Design agent workflows that launch experiments, run benchmarks and compare methods Orchestrate and monitor many agents working in parallel Build safeguards for rigor: experiment tracking, reproducibility, independent verification of results Assess what agent-driven research changes in practice: speed, coverage, failure modes 4. Evaluation & Validation Evaluate every model with rigorous, reproducible protocols. Use them to: Measure each stage with SHAD's metrics (VUS-PR for detection, NDCG for explanation, a questionnaire for interpretation) Quantify performance per failure family and scenario Identify which approaches are ready to transfer to production monitoring Expected Outcomes & Valorization Depending on results, the work may be valorized through: A scientific publication with the Scality and INRIA researchers New methods and baselines contributed to the open-source SHAD benchmark Reusable agent-based research workflows for the R&D team Technical Stack Python (primary language for modeling, experimentation and analysis) PyTorch and scikit-learn (deep learning and classical models) SHAD benchmark (github.com/scality/shad) and TSB-AD (github.com/TheDatumOrg/TSB-AD) for data, detectors and evaluation LLM-based AI agents and their orchestration tooling Candidate Profile Final-year student in a Master's program or Engineering school (Bac+5), in machine learning, data science or computer science Solid foundations in machine learning; experience with time series or anomaly detection is a strong plus Strong interest in LLMs and AI agents, and curiosity for new ways of doing research Good Python skills and hands-on experience with a deep learning framework such as PyTorch Rigorous and critical with experimental results, especially when agents produce them Autonomous and curious, able to communicate results clearly in written and spoken English Interest in distributed systems or storage is a plus, not a prerequisite Work Environment You will join a fast-paced, lean AI R&D team. French and English is our primary working language. You will benefit from: Mentorship from R&D engineers Close collaboration with INRIA researchers working on time series anomaly detection Access to real telemetry from Scality RING clusters and to the AI agent tooling the team uses for its studies A high-trust environment where your findings will directly influence engineering decisions Why Join Scality? Work on a concrete research problem with real-world industrial impact Build on a benchmark published at NeurIPS and contribute to open research Practice a new way of doing research, with fleets of AI agents as research assistants Be part of a team building infrastructure trusted by Fortune 500 companies Potential to publish research or continue as a full-time engineer after the internship Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow
