We are looking for an MD to serve as our Clinical Analytics Specialist to join the Data Discovery and Enrichment Team (DDE). The Clinical Analytics Specialist will provide support for clinical decision support (CDS) product development to improve the search and discovery experience for users of products such as ClinicalKey at the point-of-care. You will have a critical role in working with the Clinical Solutions and Education business units to provide clinical analytics support and drive growth, revenue generation, and innovation. "Active US license " and The Clinical Analytics Specialist should be a clinician (MD or DO) About the team. This team is entrusted with the validation of extracted medical information from Elsevier corpus and electronic health care records, information retrieval, creating data for gold set generation, and participating in content enrichment workflows aiding in clinical decision support. Experience Clinical degree required (MD, MBBS,GP) Preference given to those with formal training or significant experience in evidence-based medicine, clinical research, epidemiology, biostatistics, and the application of evidence to practice. Experience in semantic technologies, including text mining, ontology management is a plus. Excellent command of the English language in both spoken and written forms is required and some level of proficiency with another language is a plus. Experience with medical vocabularies such as SNOMED CT and ICD-10 is beneficial, as is knowledge of ontology modeling. Extensive computer skill competency. Visualization and dashboarding skills (e.g. using Tableau) is a plus. Demonstrated problem-solving ability, sense of urgency, and ability to prioritize tasks, to work simultaneously on multiple projects, and to ensure completion of editorial team projects per tight timelines. The Clinical Analytics Specialist should be a clinician (MD, MBBS or GP) with experience in informatics and knowledge retrieval Able to work with a variety of stakeholders at the mid and senior management level Responsibilities Appling clinical knowledge to extract and integrate data in a healthcare environment. Adapting domain ontologies for information extraction, data modeling and analysis. Building domain specific training data sets for machine learning (ML) models used in Point-of-care products Predictive analytics and insights from combining big datasets in healthcare Participating in design, prototyping, and analytics in their day to day providing insights for algorithm codification that will improve clinical workflows and content creation. Elsevier is a renowned global information analytics company that primarily focuses on providing scientific, technical, and medical (STM) research content, tools, and services. It is one of the largest publishers of academic journals and scholarly literature in the world. Elsevier operates in various domains, including science, technology, medicine, social sciences, and more. They publish a vast number of peer-reviewed journals covering a wide range of disciplines. These journals act as platforms for researchers and academics to share their findings and contribute to the advancement of knowledge in their respective fields. In addition to publishing, Elsevier offers a suite of digital solutions and services to support researchers, scientists, and professionals in their work. They provide online platforms like ScienceDirect, Scopus, and Mendeley, which offer access to a vast repository of scholarly articles, research papers, and other scientific content. These platforms often serve as essential resources for software developers seeking to stay updated with the latest scientific advancements. description: Back in 2012, we were a group of engineers and designers who decided we wanted to build things—so we did. Able started as an engineering and product hub building for a portfolio of early-stage startups. We built many relationships while developing products that were thoughtful, effective, and genuinely useful. But, since then, we’ve grown… and so has our ambition. Now, we’re entering our next chapter—defined by applied AI. AI is a powerful force in the end-to-end software development cycle, and we’re creating practices that allow us to deliver software fast and more effectively than traditional approaches, creating meaningful value for our partners. Today, our builder mindset is driving us to become an AI-native organization across every function. We’re still evolving, and that’s part of the opportunity. If you want to build, learn, and tackle challenges alongside an ambitious team, let’s build together. This position is 100% remote within LatAm. What you’ll be doing We are seeking someone who views the Knowledge Graph not just as a database, but as a living organism that requires constant care, feeding, and pruning. You understand that a RAG system is only as good as the data underlying it. You are intrigued by the complexity of ingesting massive, messy datasets and transforming them into clean, connected knowledge. In short, someone who likes: Architecting Graph ETL: Designing and developing robust ETL pipelines specifically for graph ingestion. You aren't just dumping rows into tables; you are determining how disparate data sources connect, evolve, and relate in a graph structure. Data Ingestion at Scale: Managing high-volume data streams using tools like Kafka and implementing CDC (Change Data Capture) patterns to ensure the graph reflects real-time reality. Automated Graph Hygiene: Writing scripts and jobs for deduplication, orphan node detection, and data consistency checks. You take pride in a clean schema. Modeling Time: Handling complex temporal relationships (e.g., how property ownership or financial status changes over time) within the graph. Performance Tuning: Ensuring that as the graph grows (25k+ reports and beyond), the underlying query performance remains snappy through optimizing indexes and storage. What we’re looking for We want to work with people who have a passion for collaborating with their teams, building software while nurturing inclusive and respectful relationships with their coworkers. With the ones that are open about their shortcomings and what they do not know now, but remain eager to keep on growing and closing those gaps. Ideally, they would also have: Neo4j Expertise (Must Have):4+ years of hands-on experience. You master Cypher, schema design, and the operational side of managing a production graph. ETL & Pipeline Mastery: Strong background in building data pipelines. You know how to take raw data, clean it, and structure it for graph ingestion. Streaming & CDC: Familiarity with event streaming platforms like Kafka and Change Data Capture methodologies to sync operational databases with the graph. Python Proficiency: Strong Python skills for writing ingestion scripts, maintenance jobs, and custom graph algorithms. Data Integrity Focus: Experience implementing automated jobs for entity resolution, deduplication, and quality assurance. Nice-to-Have: C# Knowledge: Ability to read or contribute to C# codebases. Domain Experience: Prior work in Finance or Real Estate sectors. Able is powered by curious, thoughtful people who care about what they build and how they build it. We’re actively investing in our team through AI training, knowledge-sharing, and hands-on experimentation to ensure everyone grows alongside the technology. This position is 100% remote within LatAm. Strong verbal and written communication skills in English are a requirement. As a team member, you can expect: To work 40 hours per week, and be available during normal business hours as needed Payments made in USD 18 days of PTO per year, observance of local holidays, and an annual break between Christmas and New Years A monthly wellness stipend and snack boxes delivered to your home About Able Able builds technology products in a portfolio model. We believe that people, teams, and processes are more important than the ideas themselves, so we’ve focused on bringing great people together, and investing in their growth. We’ve built products in a variety of industries. Everything from media to finance to toys to healthcare. Sometimes we work with management teams to help their businesses grow faster or unlock value using technology. Other times we start or buy businesses outright. Each time, we look for opportunities to leverage technology built at the portfolio-level to drive value faster. Able is committed to inclusion and diversity and is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or veteran status. description: Identity has become a critical to an organizations security posture. This is true across their entire digital landscape include cloud, traditional on prem and emerging technologies like agentic ai.Britive is at the forefront of a modern approach to delivering identity security with the only modern privileged access management platform that provides unified Privileged Access Visibility, Dynamic Privilege Management and Secrets Governance across infrastructure, platforms & SaaS. Our patent-pending technology is deployed at companies of all sizes around the world, including Fortune 500 companies. We have repeatedly ranked among the hottest Cloud Security startups. Britive is founded by CyberSecurity industry veterans with a successful prior exit and is backed by top-tier VCs. About You You are a passionate Senior Software Engineer who wants to develop and scale our multi-tenant SaaS applications on the AWS platform. You have strong hands-on technical expertise in a variety of big data technologies. From day one, you must be able to hit the ground running and bring all your experience to the team to contribute in the building of a great product. Most importantly, you have a positive “can do” attitude and a passion for delivering technical solutions in a fast-paced startup environment. Your Impact Key Responsibilities: Responsible for design and development of a large-scale data ingestion and analytics. Design and develop data pipelines for real-time and batch data processing for disparate datasets. Develop systems which can store data in highly normalized fashion to allow correlation with other data sources. Collaborate with product management and engineering teams to design and integrate software, conduct code reviews, and troubleshoot product issues. Perform proof of concepts to identify best design options including usage of AWS services. Research integration options for various SaaS/IaaS technologies, including APIs for user administration and incorporate this research in our application integration. What will you need? Required Skills: Prior experience in performing the same role in a SaaS security product company. Minimum 7 years of relevant work experience in similar roles. In-depth knowledge of Java, REST Web Services, SQL, Kafka/Kinesis, EMR/SparQL, Snowflake, AWS Neptune, Gremlin/Tinker-Pop Hands-on experience developing and delivering scalable data lakes, data ingestion and processing pipelines, data access microservices in multi-tenant environments on AWS platform. Outstanding collaboration and communication skills. Ability to effectively collaborate with distributed team. Understand and practice agile development methodology. Nice to Have: AWS Certified Developer certification is highly desired. Understanding of DevOps, microservices architecture and container/Docker technologies. Perks + Benefits: Work from anywhere in the US! We are fully remote (US only, other areas are subject to review). description: For our client in the public sector, we are seeking a Senior .NET Developer fluent in Lithuanian to join a high-impact project delivering robust backend systems and APIs for fast, secure, and scalable information access. description: AVP Data Engineering - GE05AE We’re determined to make a difference and are proud to be an insurance company that goes well beyond coverages and policies. Working here means having every opportunity to achieve your goals – and to help others accomplish theirs, too. Join our team as we help shape the future. The AVP Data Engineering – Business Insurance Ontology & Knowledge Graph is an executive-facing leadership role accountable for defining, building, and driving enterprise adoption of the Business Insurance ontology, semantic layer, and knowledge graph. This leader establishes the governed business meaning, context, and relationships that power trusted analytics, AI, agentic experiences, and decision automation across Small Business, Middle & Large Business, and Global Specialty. Operating at the intersection of commercial P&C insurance, business semantics, data architecture, graph engineering, and AI enablement, the role translates complex insurance domain knowledge—submissions, quotes, accounts, policies, coverages, exposures, risks, claims, producers, and portfolio performance—into production-ready semantic assets consumable by people, data products, LLMs, and agents. The AVP serves as the senior technical and domain authority for semantic and AI-ready data in Business Insurance, leads and leverage team of ontologists, graph modelers, semantic and AI data engineers, and business data analysts, and partners directly with the heads of Small Business, Middle & Large Business, and Global Specialty to align the ontology roadmap to growth, underwriting profitability, operational efficiency, and innovation outcomes. Must be eligible to work in the US without company sponsorship. Primary Job Responsibilities Executive Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement Serve as the primary data and semantic advisor to the heads of Small Business, Middle & Large Business, and Global Specialty, translating ontology and knowledge graph capabilities into business outcomes, investment cases, and decisions. Present strategy, roadmap, execution progress, value realized, risks, and decision asks to executive leadership, steering committees, and ELT forums in clear, plain business language. Build executive sponsorship and drive adoption of a shared Business Insurance vocabulary across underwriting, distribution, product, claims, actuarial, finance, and operations. Influence enterprise technology, data, platform, and AI strategy in partnership with Technology, Enterprise Architecture, Data & AI COE, and Applied AI teams. Negotiate priorities, resolve semantic and ownership conflicts across lines of business, and broker alignment on enterprise definitions. Act as an external and internal thought leader on ontology, knowledge graphs, agentic analytics, and AI-native data engineering in insurance. Ontology Strategy, Build & Adoption Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for the Business Insurance ontology, semantic layer, context graph, and knowledge graph. Lead the design and execution of an enterprise-scale semantic layer that standardizes business meaning and enables trusted analytics, AI, and agentic use cases. Define and operationalize ontologies modeling core commercial insurance concepts and relationships: customers, business profiles, accounts, submissions, quotes, policies, coverages, products, exposures, risks and locations, claims, producers, and portfolio performance. Establish canonical vocabularies, metric definitions, business rules, and taxonomies that standardize meaning across structured and unstructured data sources and across all three markets. Define and enforce standards and reusable patterns for ontology modeling, graph modeling, semantic interoperability, versioning, and ontology reuse across delivery teams. Drive adoption by embedding semantic models into data products, analytics, AI pipelines, APIs, and activation layers; measure and report adoption and business value. Move capabilities from strategy to pilot to scaled enterprise production, prioritizing high-value use cases such as submission triage, risk appetite, clearance, pricing and underwriting insights, portfolio management, and cross-sell. AI & Data Engineering Enable semantic-first AI and agentic analytics, ensuring LLMs and agents consume governed business context, metrics, rules, and relationships. Lead implementation of AI data pipelines integrating structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data (e.g., submissions, loss runs, schedules, broker correspondence) to support AI and agentic solutions. Operationalize ontologies through knowledge graphs, metadata services, data APIs, vector stores, RAG pipelines, and production data platforms in partnership with AI Data Architects and Engineers. Design and oversee scalable real-time and batch data pipelines for efficient ingestion, processing, and delivery. Drive production-scale execution of semantic and graph platforms with strong standards for performance, reliability, security, and lifecycle management. Ensure explainability by making AI and analytical outputs traceable to governed semantic definitions, relationships, rules, and source data. Champion AI-augmented productivity across the data lifecycle, including AI-generated pipelines, automated data quality, DataOps, and AI-assisted ontology engineering. Evaluate emerging technologies in agentic AI, knowledge graphs, and data engineering; lead proofs of value and pilots to accelerate speed to market. Governance, Team & Financial Leadership Align ontologies and graph models with enterprise data governance, stewardship, metadata, lineage, quality, privacy, and security standards; establish semantic ownership and change control with business data owners. Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of ontologists, graph modelers, semantic and AI data engineers, business data analysts, and release train engineers, including onshore and offshore talent. Manage the portfolio budget, vendor partners, and financials; deliver measurable return on investment. Operate within Scaled Agile and portfolio/value stream frameworks, partnering closely with product owners and cross-functional delivery teams. Evangelize agentic data engineering and semantic practices through communities of practice, reference patterns, playbooks, and enablement materials. Commercial P&C Domain Knowledge (Required) Deep understanding of the commercial P&C value chain: distribution and producer management, submission intake, clearance, risk appetite, underwriting, rating and pricing, quote and bind, policy administration, endorsements, renewals, billing, claims, and reinsurance. Working knowledge of commercial lines and products such as Workers' Compensation, General Liability, Commercial Property, Commercial Auto, Business Owner's Policy, Umbrella/Excess, Management and Professional Liability, and specialty lines. Understanding of how Small Business, Middle & Large Business, and Global Specialty differ in distribution model, underwriting approach, account complexity, and data needs. Familiarity with core insurance concepts and measures: exposures and rating bases (payroll, sales, TIV, vehicles), class codes (NAICS/SIC), insured locations, account rounding, hit/quote/bind ratios, written and earned premium, loss ratio, combined ratio, retention, and rate change. Familiarity with industry data standards and reference models such as ACORD, ISO, and NCCI. Skills & Experience Leadership & Communication Exceptional executive presence with proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts simply and persuasively to C-suite, line-of-business heads, and board-level audiences. Strong executive influence, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills; track record of building cross-functional coalitions and driving enterprise-wide adoption without direct authority. Proven ability to frame investment cases, value metrics, and decisions for senior leadership. Ability to lead in a lean, agile, fast-paced environment using Scaled Agile principles. Semantic, Ontology & Knowledge Graph Deep expertise in semantic layer architecture, ontology modeling, graph modeling, and knowledge graph design at enterprise scale. Hands-on mastery of RDF, OWL 2, RDFS, SKOS, SHACL, SPARQL, and W3C semantic web standards; familiarity with labeled property graphs and query languages such as Cypher or GQL. Experience designing and operating enterprise knowledge graphs on platforms such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Stardog, or Spanner Graph. Experience integrating knowledge graphs with LLMs, RAG and GraphRAG pipelines, vector stores, and agentic frameworks. Strong understanding of context-aware data engineering, canonical modeling, semantic interoperability, and AI consumption patterns, including embeddings, grounding, reasoning, and explainability. Data & AI Engineering Mastery of data engineering and architecture, including lakehouses, data integration, data domains, data products, data APIs, real-time streaming, and conversational BI. Experience implementing scalable AI-driven data systems supporting agentic solutions (e.g., AWS Lambda, S3, EC2, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, A2A). Technical expertise in LLMs, prompt engineering, LLM optimization, RAG architectures, and vector databases (e.g., Vertex AI, Postgres, OpenSearch, Pinecone). Hands-on experience with multi-cloud environments across AWS, GCP, and Snowflake. Strong grounding in data governance, metadata management, lineage, data quality, privacy, and security. Education, Experience, Certifications and Licenses Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 12+ years in data engineering, data architecture, and large-scale data ecosystems, including 8+ years of hands-on semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph work. 7+ years in senior leadership roles managing complex data and AI portfolios, with direct engagement with executive and line-of-business leadership. 5+ years in commercial Property & Casualty insurance; experience across Small Business, Middle Market, or Specialty strongly preferred. Industry designations such as CPCU, AINS, or AU are a plus. Compensation The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. Actual base pay could vary and may be above or below the listed range based on factors including but not limited to performance, proficiency and demonstration of competencies required for the role. The base pay is just one component of The Hartford’s total compensation package for employees. Other rewards may include short-term or annual bonuses, long-term incentives, and on-the-spot recognition. The annualized base pay range for this role is: $182,000 - $273,000 Equal Opportunity Employer/Sex/Race/Color/Veterans/Disability/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity or Expression/Religion/Age About Us | Our Culture | What It’s Like to Work Here | Perks & Benefits Originally posted on Himalayas

Primary Job Responsibilities Executive Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement Serve as the primary data and semantic advisor to the heads of Small Business, Middle & Large Business, and Global Specialty, translating ontology and knowledge graph capabilities into business outcomes, investment cases, and decisions. Present strategy, roadmap, execution progress, value realized, risks, and decision asks to executive leadership, steering committees, and ELT forums in clear, plain business language. Build executive sponsorship and drive adoption of a shared Business Insurance vocabulary across underwriting, distribution, product, claims, actuarial, finance, and operations. Influence enterprise technology, data, platform, and AI strategy in partnership with Technology, Enterprise Architecture, Data & AI COE, and Applied AI teams. Negotiate priorities, resolve semantic and ownership conflicts across lines of business, and broker alignment on enterprise definitions. Act as an external and internal thought leader on ontology, knowledge graphs, agentic analytics, and AI-native data engineering in insurance. Ontology Strategy, Build & Adoption Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for the Business Insurance ontology, semantic layer, context graph, and knowledge graph. Lead the design and execution of an enterprise-scale semantic layer that standardizes business meaning and enables trusted analytics, AI, and agentic use cases. Define and operationalize ontologies modeling core commercial insurance concepts and relationships: customers, business profiles, accounts, submissions, quotes, policies, coverages, products, exposures, risks and locations, claims, producers, and portfolio performance. Establish canonical vocabularies, metric definitions, business rules, and taxonomies that standardize meaning across structured and unstructured data sources and across all three markets. Define and enforce standards and reusable patterns for ontology modeling, graph modeling, semantic interoperability, versioning, and ontology reuse across delivery teams. Drive adoption by embedding semantic models into data products, analytics, AI pipelines, APIs, and activation layers; measure and report adoption and business value. Move capabilities from strategy to pilot to scaled enterprise production, prioritizing high-value use cases such as submission triage, risk appetite, clearance, pricing and underwriting insights, portfolio management, and cross-sell. AI & Data Engineering Enable semantic-first AI and agentic analytics, ensuring LLMs and agents consume governed business context, metrics, rules, and relationships. Lead implementation of AI data pipelines integrating structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data (e.g., submissions, loss runs, schedules, broker correspondence) to support AI and agentic solutions. Operationalize ontologies through knowledge graphs, metadata services, data APIs, vector stores, RAG pipelines, and production data platforms in partnership with AI Data Architects and Engineers. Design and oversee scalable real-time and batch data pipelines for efficient ingestion, processing, and delivery. Drive production-scale execution of semantic and graph platforms with strong standards for performance, reliability, security, and lifecycle management. Ensure explainability by making AI and analytical outputs traceable to governed semantic definitions, relationships, rules, and source data. Champion AI-augmented productivity across the data lifecycle, including AI-generated pipelines, automated data quality, DataOps, and AI-assisted ontology engineering. Evaluate emerging technologies in agentic AI, knowledge graphs, and data engineering; lead proofs of value and pilots to accelerate speed to market. Governance, Team & Financial Leadership Align ontologies and graph models with enterprise data governance, stewardship, metadata, lineage, quality, privacy, and security standards; establish semantic ownership and change control with business data owners. Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing team of ontologists, graph modelers, semantic and AI data engineers, business data analysts, and release train engineers, including onshore and offshore talent. Manage the portfolio budget, vendor partners, and financials; deliver measurable return on investment. Operate within Scaled Agile and portfolio/value stream frameworks, partnering closely with product owners and cross-functional delivery teams. Evangelize agentic data engineering and semantic practices through communities of practice, reference patterns, playbooks, and enablement materials. Commercial P&C Domain Knowledge (Required) Deep understanding of the commercial P&C value chain: distribution and producer management, submission intake, clearance, risk appetite, underwriting, rating and pricing, quote and bind, policy administration, endorsements, renewals, billing, claims, and reinsurance. Working knowledge of commercial lines and products such as Workers' Compensation, General Liability, Commercial Property, Commercial Auto, Business Owner's Policy, Umbrella/Excess, Management and Professional Liability, and specialty lines. Understanding of how Small Business, Middle & Large Business, and Global Specialty differ in distribution model, underwriting approach, account complexity, and data needs. Familiarity with core insurance concepts and measures: exposures and rating bases (payroll, sales, TIV, vehicles), class codes (NAICS/SIC), insured locations, account rounding, hit/quote/bind ratios, written and earned premium, loss ratio, combined ratio, retention, and rate change. Familiarity with industry data standards and reference models such as ACORD, ISO, and NCCI. Skills & Experience Leadership & Communication Exceptional executive presence with proven ability to communicate complex technical concepts simply and persuasively to C-suite, line-of-business heads, and board-level audiences. Strong executive influence, negotiation, and conflict resolution skills; track record of building cross-functional coalitions and driving enterprise-wide adoption without direct authority. Proven ability to frame investment cases, value metrics, and decisions for senior leadership. Ability to lead in a lean, agile, fast-paced environment using Scaled Agile principles. Semantic, Ontology & Knowledge Graph Deep expertise in semantic layer architecture, ontology modeling, graph modeling, and knowledge graph design at enterprise scale. Hands-on mastery of RDF, OWL 2, RDFS, SKOS, SHACL, SPARQL, and W3C semantic web standards; familiarity with labeled property graphs and query languages such as Cypher or GQL. Experience designing and operating enterprise knowledge graphs on platforms such as Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Stardog, or Spanner Graph. Experience integrating knowledge graphs with LLMs, RAG and GraphRAG pipelines, vector stores, and agentic frameworks. Strong understanding of context-aware data engineering, canonical modeling, semantic interoperability, and AI consumption patterns, including embeddings, grounding, reasoning, and explainability. Data & AI Engineering Mastery of data engineering and architecture, including lakehouses, data integration, data domains, data products, data APIs, real-time streaming, and conversational BI. Experience implementing scalable AI-driven data systems supporting agentic solutions (e.g., AWS Lambda, S3, EC2, LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, A2A). Technical expertise in LLMs, prompt engineering, LLM optimization, RAG architectures, and vector databases (e.g., Vertex AI, Postgres, OpenSearch, Pinecone). Hands-on experience with multi-cloud environments across AWS, GCP, and Snowflake. Strong grounding in data governance, metadata management, lineage, data quality, privacy, and security. Education, Experience, Certifications and Licenses Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience. 12+ years in data engineering, data architecture, and large-scale data ecosystems, including 8+ years of hands-on semantic, ontology, or knowledge graph work. 7+ years in senior leadership roles managing complex data and AI portfolios, with direct engagement with executive and line-of-business leadership. 5+ years in commercial Property & Casualty insurance; experience across Small Business, Middle Market, or Specialty strongly preferred. Industry designations such as CPCU, AINS, or AU are a plus. Compensation The listed annualized base pay range is primarily based on analysis of similar positions in the external market. We help industry-leading enterprises break free from legacy systems and adopt AI that reshapes how teams build, deliver, and thrive at scale. description: Overview LMI is seeking an experienced Data Engineer – Army Vantage / Palantir Foundry to support the U.S. Army Training Information System (ATIS) program. This hands-on role will develop, maintain, and improve ATIS data products and integrations, with a primary focus on capabilities delivered through Army Vantage and Palantir Foundry. The Data Engineer will transform authoritative ATIS data into reliable, reusable enterprise data products and ensure Vantage/Foundry capabilities integrate effectively with the broader ATIS data ecosystem. The ideal candidate has hands-on Foundry experience, strong data-engineering skills, and the ability to independently identify and resolve end-to-end data quality and integration issues across ATIS and Vantage/Foundry. LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed. Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value. Responsibilities Develop, maintain, troubleshoot, and enhance ATIS data products, datasets, pipelines, applications, dashboards, and related capabilities within Army Vantage/Palantir Foundry. Design, build, and sustain production-quality data pipelines and transformations using Python, SQL, PySpark, and native Foundry capabilities. Develop and maintain Foundry ontology objects, relationships, and data models that make authoritative ATIS data understandable, reusable, and accessible to approved users. Integrate authoritative ATIS data with Vantage/Foundry and other Army enterprise data sources while maintaining data quality, lineage, and appropriate access controls. Trace, diagnose, and drive resolution of end-to-end data quality and integration issues across ATIS source data, interfaces, transformations, pipelines, and Vantage/Foundry products. Develop Foundry-native dashboards, applications, reports, and other data products to support Army analytics, visualization, reporting, and mission needs. Implement data-quality validation, monitoring, scheduling, error handling, and other practices necessary to operate reliable production data products. Apply sound software and data-engineering practices, including version control, peer review, testing, documentation, and CI/CD where supported. Work directly with product owners, engineers, architects, analysts, and users to translate mission needs into practical technical solutions and support appropriate use of authoritative ATIS data. Document solutions, share knowledge, and build team capability so ATIS can sustain and extend its data and Foundry capabilities without creating single-person dependencies. Operate as a self-directed member of the Agile team, taking ownership of technical outcomes and independently driving problems toward resolution. Qualifications Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience. 4+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data integration, software development, or development of production data products. Hands-on experience developing or maintaining solutions in Palantir Foundry and/or Army Vantage, with sufficient familiarity to contribute with limited platform-specific ramp-up. Strong proficiency in SQL and Python for data transformation, analysis, automation, and troubleshooting. Experience designing, building, and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines involving complex or disparate datasets. Experience with data modeling, including schemas, keys, relationships, reference data, and transformation of source data into reusable data products. Experience with Foundry ontology, semantic data models, or comparable enterprise data structures. Experience with PySpark, Spark, Pandas, or comparable technologies for transforming complex datasets. Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot data pipelines, integrations, data-quality issues, and production data products, including tracing problems across source systems and downstream consumers. Ability to work independently from mission intent or a desired end state while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary technical and product teams. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to nontechnical stakeholders. Active DoD Secret security clearance. Preferred Qualifications Direct experience developing and sustaining data products within Army Vantage. Experience integrating DoD/Army authoritative data sources and working with enterprise data-quality, lineage, governance, and access-control requirements. Experience developing Foundry-native applications, dashboards, reports, or custom interfaces. Experience applying software-engineering practices such as Git/version control, peer review, automated testing, and CI/CD to data products. Familiarity with APIs, cloud data services, and enterprise system integration. Experience working within an Agile or SAFe Agile Release Train (ART) environment. Applicable DoD 8140 cybersecurity/workforce qualification, where required. Experience supporting Army, DoD, federal, or other secure/regulated mission systems. Target salary range: $120,000 - $155,000 Disclaimer: The salary range displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is not a guarantee of compensation. Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances. description: Standard Job Description Join Lockheed Martin’s Data & AI Enablement organization and accelerate the company’s AI transformation. As a lead data architect, you will drive the creation of logical data models that underpin our next‑generation data products and enterprise ontology. You will partner with Data Product Owners by architecting data models, data pipelines and ontologies, and ensure consistent semantic definitions across the Enterprise Data Ecosystem (EDE). The role operates in a Databricks‑centric environment, integrating source systems such as SAP and Apriso upstream, and powering AI agents and analytics applications downstream. By governing and expanding the semantic layer of the corporate data foundation, you will play a key role in the company’s AI transformation. Key Responsibilities Partner with Data Product Owners to capture business requirements and create robust logical data models. Design federated ontologies and knowledge‑graph structures that enrich data products and support AI agents, AI reasoning, and analytics applications. Ensure models deliver clean, well‑documented feature sets for machine‑learning pipelines; work with data scientists to embed model‑ready attributes (feature stores, lineage metadata). Define logical representations for SAP, Apriso, and other source systems and guide ingestion patterns that preserve semantic integrity. Produce architecture artifacts (diagrams, data dictionaries, ontology catalogs) and enforce data‑quality, security, and lineage standards. Design data entities in a way so that they can be productized to ensure they meet the requirements of their documented use cases. Collaborate with the Lead Data Engineer to validate designs. Continuously improve modeling processes, promote ontology reuse, and stay current on semantic‑modeling and Databricks advancements. Advise on the technology stack used in team operations. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s (or higher) in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Management, or a related field. 10 + years of large-scale data architecture/engineering experience, with at least 5 years focused on productizing data assets for enterprise consumption. Significant experience designing/operationalizing ontologies. Demonstrated ability to probe for and understand core customer needs as opposed to surface-level needs. Strong programming skills in Python and SQL; proficient with Spark (PySpark/Scala) and deep experience with AI-assisted development. Experience with data‑integration/orchestration tools (e.g., NiFi, Airflow) for pipeline development. Must be a US Citizen. Desired Skills Experience with Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Jobs/Workflows). Experience with federated data models and ontologies. Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills for cross‑functional teamwork and internal‑customer support. Master’s degree or advanced technical training (optional). Databricks certifications (Data Engineer Associate/Professional) or comparable big‑data credentials. Experience developing applications leveraging genAI. Pay Information GeoZone Definition: GeoZones are geographic groupings created by Lockheed Martin to align compensation ranges with regional labor markets and cost-of-labor differences across the United States. Locations are assigned a Geo Zone based on the primary work location of the role. Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 1): $185400.00 - $344400.00 Includes metropolitan areas such as Sunnyvale CA; Pal Alto, CA; New York City metropolitan area; Newark, New Jersey; etc. Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 2): $166900.00 - $309900.00 Includes metropolitan areas such as Denver, CO; King of Prussia, PA; Stratford, CT; Moorestown, NJ; etc. Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 3): $148300.00 - $275500.00 Includes metropolitan areas such as Dallas–Fort Worth, TX; Orlando, FL; Grand Prairie, TX; Marietta, GA; etc. Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $133500.00 - $247900.00 Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Lufkin, TX; etc. At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally. Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer. Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability. This role serves as the technical leader for complex client engagements and establishes VeilSun's capabilities across the Siemens and Altair platform stack: Mendix, Graph Studio (formerly Altair Graph Studio and Anzo) and AI Studio (formerly Altair RapidMiner). The position requires someone who can move from business problem to technical architecture, determine how the three layers of the platform should work together, build the first versions personally, and provide hands-on guidance to the teams implementing those solutions. This person will work closely with clients, project teams, developers and practice leadership to ensure solutions are practical, scalable, secure, maintainable and aligned with business outcomes. You will be measured on: Successful architecture and delivery of Mendix, Graph Studio and AI Studio solutions Quality, scalability, security and maintainability of solution designs Ability to translate complex business problems into clear technical approaches Effectiveness of technical leadership provided to project teams Growth of VeilSun's internal enterprise AI and knowledge graph expertise, standards, reusable patterns and delivery capabilities Ability to identify appropriate uses of AI, agents, knowledge graphs, workflow automation and traditional application logic Successful collaboration with clients, developers, project managers and other technical stakeholders Contribution to discovery, solutioning, estimation and presales activities Core Responsibilities Lead technical solutions Personally build the first Graph Studio models and AI Studio pipelines on early engagements, then turn them into patterns the team can repeat Build knowledge graphs in Graph Studio: onboard data from ERP, PLM and SQL sources, design or extend ontologies, write SPARQL, deploy and tune Build and deploy machine learning pipelines and AI agents in AI Studio, AI Hub and Agent and maintainable integration patterns using APIs, events, middleware and other enterprise integration approaches Provide architectural direction throughout the full delivery lifecycle, including discovery, design, implementation, deployment and support Work directly with developers to review implementations, resolve complex technical issues and reinforce development and architecture standards risks, dependencies, assumptions and tradeoffs Support estimates, technical solutioning, proposals and presales conversations for enterprise AI, knowledge graph and Mendix opportunities Establish reusable patterns, reference architectures, standards and best practices for Mendix, Graph Studio and AI Studio delivery Mentor Mendix developers and other technical team members as VeilSun expands its enterprise AI and knowledge graph capabilities Stay current with changes across the Mendix, Siemens and Altair ecosystems, including Graph Studio and AI Studio, and help determine when new capabilities should be adopted Decision Authority You have authority to: Define and recommend the technical architecture for assigned Mendix, Graph Studio and AI Studio solutions Determine appropriate architectural patterns, integration approaches and technology usage within established project and organizational constraints Recommend whether a business capability should be implemented using traditional application logic, workflow automation, AI, machine learning, agentic capabilities or a combination of approaches Establish technical standards and implementation guidance for project teams Require remediation of architectural, security, scalability or maintainability concerns that create meaningful delivery or client risk Escalate technical risks, dependencies or scope concerns that may impact successful delivery Recommend reusable components, reference architectures, tools and patterns for broader practice adoption Provide technical input into project estimates, staffing needs, delivery approaches and solution feasibility Desired Behaviors and Attributes Thinks in terms of the complete business and technical system rather than a single application or technology Is comfortable working through ambiguity and turning loosely defined business problems into clear technical approaches Balances technical sophistication with practical delivery needs and avoids unnecessary complexity Can communicate complex technical concepts clearly to developers, business stakeholders and client leadership Stays hands-on: builds, validates technical decisions and helps teams through difficult implementation challenges Approaches AI pragmatically and understands that AI is not the right solution for every problem Considers security, governance, maintainability, supportability and long-term ownership as part of architecture decisions Coaches and develops others rather than becoming a bottleneck for technical decisions Proactively identifies risks, assumptions, dependencies and areas where additional discovery is required Continuously learns as the Mendix, Siemens, Altair, enterprise AI and knowledge graph ecosystems evolve Failure Patterns We Avoid Treating enterprise AI and knowledge graph work as simply another Mendix development project Defaulting to AI or agentic solutions where straightforward application logic or workflow would be more reliable Designing technically impressive solutions that are unnecessarily difficult to build, support or maintain Building AI capabilities without sufficient attention to security, data access, governance, auditability or human oversight Creating knowledge graphs or semantic models without a clear business purpose Making architecture decisions without considering existing enterprise systems, integration constraints or client capabilities Designing in isolation without involving the developers and teams responsible for implementing and supporting the solution Allowing architectural standards to become theoretical documentation that does not influence actual implementation Becoming a required approval point for every technical decision instead of enabling teams to operate hire Significant experience designing and delivering enterprise software solutions, including leading technical discovery and solution architecture for complex projects US person, able to pass client Property graph experience (Neo4j, TigerGraph, Cypher, Gremlin) is useful background but not a substitute for RDF and SPARQL Understanding of modern AI concepts including large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, AI agents, context engineering, tool use and human-in-the-loop workflows Experience designing or implementing enterprise generative AI, RAG, machine learning or agentic AI solutions, with Python scripting inside pipelines Understanding of cloud architecture, identity and access management, application security, observability and enterprise deployment patterns Experience with Siemens technologies such as Teamcenter, Opcenter, NX, Polarion or Insights Hub Experience with Snowflake, Databricks or similar data platforms Experience in manufacturing, energy and utilities, transportation, engineering, aerospace and defense, life sciences or other complex enterprise environments Familiarity with concepts such as PLM, MES, digital thread, digital twin, BOM, engineering change management, manufacturing quality or asset lifecycle management Experience mentoring developers or providing technical leadership across delivery teams Compensation & Benefits The annual base salary range for this position is $160,000–$190,000, depending on experience. description: About Outreach Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few. The Role We are looking for a Director of Applied Science and Engineering to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of Outreach's Knowledge Graph and contextual AI capabilities. This is a senior leadership position for someone who combines deep technical expertise in knowledge representation, graph-based learning, and reasoning systems with the ability to build, inspire, and scale a high-performing team. You will own the end-to-end technical direction of a per-tenant contextual knowledge graph that captures the full complexity of each customer's sales environment: accounts, deals, contacts, rep behaviors, competitive landscape, and the signals buried in calls, emails, and CRM activity. This graph is the reasoning backbone of the platform, powering next-best-action recommendations, deal risk signals, coaching suggestions, competitive intelligence, and agentic AI workflows. In this role, you will set the research agenda, define the architecture, hire and grow the team, and drive measurable business impact through applied science innovation. Your Daily Adventures Will Include: Technical Vision & Strategy: Define and own the multi-year technical roadmap for Outreach's Knowledge Graph platform, including entity resolution, temporal reasoning, graph-based learning, and contextual inference. Translate business objectives into a coherent applied science strategy that balances research ambition with production delivery. Team Leadership: Build, hire, and lead a team of applied scientists and research engineers. Establish team culture, research rigor, career development frameworks, and a high bar for both scientific quality and production impact. Mentor senior ICs into technical leaders. Knowledge Graph Architecture: Drive the design of per-tenant knowledge graph schemas, ontologies, and data models tailored to the sales execution domain. Own decisions on graph databases, query languages, storage engines, and tenant isolation strategies at scale. Information Extraction at Scale: Oversee pipelines that extract structured knowledge from unstructured conversational and document data (sales calls, emails, CRM notes), including coreference resolution, relation extraction, event detection, and entity linking. Reasoning & Inference Systems: Lead the development of reasoning and inference layers over the knowledge graph to power next-best-action suggestions, deal risk scoring, coaching recommendations, competitive intelligence, and agentic AI decision-making. Representation Learning & Graph ML: Direct research into graph-based models (GNNs, relational embeddings, link prediction, temporal graph networks) over heterogeneous, multi-relational graph structures to support downstream reasoning, retrieval, and recommendation tasks. Cross-functional Leadership: Partner with leaders in Engineering, Product, Design, and Data to align science investments with product priorities. Represent the applied science function in executive reviews, roadmap planning, and technical design reviews. Research-to-Production Pipeline: Establish processes and infrastructure for moving from research exploration to production deployment: experiment tracking, model evaluation frameworks, A/B testing, and continuous model improvement loops. Industry & Academic Engagement: Keep the team at the frontier of knowledge graph research. Foster connections with the academic community through conference participation, publications, and strategic academic partnerships. Our Vision Of You: PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, NLP, or a related field with a focus on knowledge representation and reasoning, graph neural networks, information extraction, recommender systems or conversational AI and dialogue systems 10+ years of experience in applied science or machine learning, with at least 3 years in a people leadership role managing teams of 5+ applied scientists or research engineers. Demonstrated track record of building and shipping knowledge graph, NLP, or graph ML systems at production scale: not just publishing papers, but delivering measurable business outcomes. Deep expertise in at least three of: knowledge graph construction, entity resolution, information extraction, graph neural networks, temporal reasoning, representation learning, or recommender systems. Strong engineering fundamentals. You can write production-quality code, not just prototype notebooks. Proficiency in Python / Golang; and graph databases or query languages (e.g., Neo4j, SPARQL, Cypher) is required. Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining top applied science talent. You have grown ICs into senior technical leaders and built teams with a strong shipping culture. Executive communication skills. You can translate complex research concepts into business impact narratives for C-suite and board audiences. Comfort with deep ambiguity. You will define the problem space, not just solve well-scoped problems. You thrive when chartering new technical directions from scratch. Strong Ownership: Take end-to-end responsibility for research and model development initiatives, from problem formulation and data analysis through experimentation, production deployment, and ongoing performance monitoring, driving outcomes with minimal oversight. Nice To Have: Experience building multi-tenant knowledge graph systems with per-customer isolation and scale requirements. Background in sales, revenue, or B2B SaaS domains: understanding of deal cycles, pipeline management, and CRM data models. Experience integrating knowledge graphs with LLM-based systems (RAG architectures, tool-augmented generation, agentic frameworks). Strong communication skills with the ability to translate research concepts into product impact for cross-functional audiences. Publications in top-tier venues (KDD, NeurIPS, ACL, EMNLP, ICLR, WWW, SIGIR, etc.) in knowledge graphs, NLP, or graph learning. Experience with graph databases at scale (Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, or similar) including performance tuning, query optimization, and multi-region deployment. Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar agent-tool integration patterns. Track record of building applied science teams from scratch (0→1 team formation). Why Join Us? Foundational Leadership: You will define how Outreach thinks about knowledge representation and contextual reasoning, decisions that shape the platform for years. This is not an optimization role; it is a charter-defining one. Greenfield Architecture: Build the knowledge graph platform from the ground up with the latitude to make foundational technical decisions on schema design, graph infrastructure, and reasoning systems. Scale & Impact: Outreach processes millions of sales interactions across 4,000+ enterprise customers. Your team's work will directly power agentic AI workflows that change how revenue teams operate globally. Executive Visibility: Direct exposure to top leadership in the company. Present research direction and results at the executive level. World-Class Team: Join a culture that values scientific rigor, engineering excellence, and intellectual honesty. Collaborate with senior engineers, product leaders, and data scientists who care deeply about getting it right. Growth into executive level: For the right leader, this role is a path to executive level as the function scales. You will shape not just the technology but the organizational structure of applied science at Outreach. Why You’ll Love It Here ● Highly competitive salary ● 25 days annual vacation time + sick time and casual leave ● Group medical policy coverage available to employees and up to 5 eligible family members ● OPD benefit covered up to INR 10,000 ● Life insurance and personal accident insurance at 3x annual CTC ● 26 weeks of maternity leave pay, and 15 days of paternity leave pay ● Opportunity to be part of company success via the RSU program ● Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups like OWN+ (Outreach Women's Network), Adelante (Latinx community), OBX (Outreach Black Connection), Mosaic (AAPI community), Pride (LGBTQIA+), Gender+, Disability Community, and Veterans/Military ● Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team ● Fun company and team outings because we play just as hard as we work Outreach is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status. Our success is reliant on building teams that include people from different backgrounds and experiences who can elevate assumptions and ideas with fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to hiring the whole human, not just a resume. To that end, we look for a diverse pool of applicants-including those from historically marginalized groups. We would like to invite you to apply even if you don't think you meet all of the requirements listed below. We don't want a few lines in a job description to get between us and the opportunity to meet you. Originally posted on Himalayas

description: Parachute Health is transforming post-acute care as the leading digital ordering platform for medical equipment and supplies. We connect major health systems, health plans, and suppliers to help patients get the life-saving products they need at home. Since launching, we've connected 300,000+ clinicians and 3,000+ supplier locations across all 50 states and helped 15M+ patients. What started as a DME ePrescribing tool has become the order management platform of choice for home medical equipment. Join our team and make a difference in patient care. About the Role Parachute Health is building the most complete and accurate catalog of home medical equipment and supplies in the industry, and that catalog is at the heart of our entire platform. Over the last few months, a consultant improved our in-house design standards, style guide, review practices, and an early set of universal merchandising attributes. We are now hiring someone in-house to take that work over and grow it for the long term. As our Catalog Taxonomist, you will be the expert on our taxonomy, information architecture, and catalog data model. You will serve as the catalog administrator, set and enforce catalog standards, and own catalog functionality enhancements from requirements definition and justification all the way through operational implementation. Reporting to the SVP of Merchandising Operations, you will partner closely with Operations, Product, Design, and Engineering, to make sure the catalog stays accurate, scalable, and easy to work in as we expand into new categories. A large part of this job is working shoulder to shoulder with engineers and a product manager. You will sit with the Cat Crew R&D team, translate merchandising problems into requirements they can build against, and translate technical constraints back into business impact for the rest of the organization. Just as important, you will be the person who notices when the platform is quietly costing the team time or accuracy, names that gap clearly, sizes it, and advocates for fixing it. The groundwork is fairly new, so you will have a solid base to start from and real room to decide where it goes next. You get to grow the skills of an already highly-motivated Merchandising team and make the group even stronger. You will also influence R&D strategy as we build and enhance our catalog software capabilities,and partner with our clinical division as we launch new categories together. What You'll Do Own the standards and structure of the global product taxonomy, category hierarchy, and catalog data model, and evolve them as we expand into new categories. Partner closely with the Cat Crew R&D team to shape near-term catalog software capabilities. Work directly with engineers through scoping, development, and delivery rather than handing off a spec and walking away. Own catalog functionality enhancement requirements end to end: definition, business justification, and the case for prioritization, then drive them forward with the Catalog Product Manager and Engineering. Surface gaps between what the business needs and what the platform does today. Document the workarounds people have quietly adopted, quantify what they cost in time, accuracy, or scalability, and bring that case to Product and Engineering leadership. Serve as the catalog administrator: govern attributes, values, naming conventions, and data-quality standards across the catalog. Maintain and evolve core catalog assets, including the global catalog style guide, training about existing and new functionality, glossary, and design review guide. Interview category managers and subject-matter experts to learn each category's ideal state, balanced with a curiosity about current state workarounds and platform limitations. Lead design reviews for category managers and analysts and provide effective feedback. Up-level the merchandising team's catalog and taxonomy skills, continuing the trajectory started with the contract taxonomist. Drive the standardized identification of sourcing/provenance attributes, including manufacturer, brand, and product line. Set the long-term strategic direction for catalog data management, quality, and governance, and act as the senior authority the organization consults on catalog and taxonomy decisions. Collaborate with our clinical division to launch new categories, making sure the catalog and taxonomy support new clinical use cases. Advance AI-assisted catalog tooling and workflows, such as Claude skills for catalog building and quality monitoring, and codify repeatable processes. About You Deep expertise in taxonomy, information architecture, and metadata or attribute modeling, ideally for a large, complex product catalog. Hands-on experience administering catalog or product information management (PIM) systems and defining data-quality standards. A track record of spotting business gaps and doing something about them. You notice when a process is broken or a tool is falling short, you can articulate the cost in concrete terms, and you can make the case for investment to people who did not ask for it. A track record of turning ambiguous catalog problems into clear requirements, and of justifying and prioritizing enhancement work against business impact. Strong cross-functional partnership skills, and comfort being the in-house authority who sets standards and makes the final call on catalog structure. Systems thinking and a bias to build durable processes, documentation, and tooling rather than one-off fixes. Motivated to up-level a team that is early in building these skills, and open to direct or dotted-line management as the function matures. Healthcare, DME, or medical supplies domain experience is a plus, not a requirement. Knowledge of or experience in semantic web standards OWL and SKOS is a bonus. description: While technology is the heart of our business, a global and diverse culture is the heart of our success. We love our people and we take pride in catering them to a culture built on transparency, diversity, integrity, learning and growth. If working in an environment that encourages you to innovate and excel, not just in professional but personal life, interests you- you would enjoy your career with Quantiphi! About Quantiphi Quantiphi is an award-winning, AI-First digital engineering and consulting company focused on delivering high-impact Services and Solutions that help organizations solve what truly matters. We partner with enterprises to reimagine their businesses through intelligent, scalable, and transformative AI—driving measurable outcomes at the very core of their operations. Since our founding in 2013, Quantiphi has tackled some of the world’s most complex business challenges by combining deep industry expertise, disciplined cloud and data engineering practices, and cutting-edge applied AI research. Our work is rooted in delivering accelerated, quantifiable business value—not just technology for technology’s sake. Headquartered in Boston, Quantiphi is a global organization with 4,000+ professionals serving clients across key industry verticals, including BFSI, Healthcare & Life Sciences, CPG, MFG, TME etc. As an Elite and Premier partner to leading cloud and AI platforms such as NVIDIA, Google Cloud, AWS, and Snowflake, we build and deliver enterprise-grade AI services and solutions that create real-world impact. For more details, visit: Website or LinkedIn Page. Role: Senior Knowledge Graph Engineer Experience: 5+ years of software/data engineering experience Employment Type: Full-Time (US Remote) Work Location: US Remote (Up to 25% travel to client sites across the US) Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Knowledge Graph Engineer to design, build, and productionize knowledge graph solutions for healthcare and clinical data. Our architecture uses a hybrid graph approach, combining a Labeled Property Graph (LPG) for patient/clinical data with an RDF-based graph for clinical ontology and semantic knowledge. The role will focus on translating ontology and mapping specifications into scalable graph solutions, including data transformation, graph ingestion, concept/entity linking, provenance, validation, and querying. You will work closely with ontology, terminology, FHIR, clinical/domain, and data engineering teams to translate agreed semantic and mapping decisions into robust technical implementations. Key Responsibilities: Develop, implement, build, and maintain production knowledge graph solutions across LPG and RDF graph technologies. Build scalable pipelines to transform healthcare/FHIR data into appropriate graph representations. Implement mappings between patient/clinical data and concepts represented in the clinical ontology. Develop reusable mapping and transformation patterns rather than one-off implementations. Implement consistent approaches for entity identity, canonical identifiers/URI/IRI, relationships, and concept linking. Maintain provenance and traceability between source data, mapping rules, and resulting graph entities and relationships. Develop and optimize graph queries using Cypher and/or SPARQL. Implement automated validation and testing to identify unresolved mappings, inconsistent relationships, and other graph-quality issues. Work with ontology, FHIR, terminology, and clinical SMEs to clarify ambiguous or missing mapping requirements. Participate in technical design, architecture reviews, code reviews, and engineering best practices. Required Qualifications: 5+ years of software/data engineering experience, including hands-on experience with knowledge graphs or graph technologies. Strong understanding of knowledge graph and graph data modeling concepts. Hands-on experience with either:Labeled Property Graphs, such as Neo4j/Cypher or equivalent, orRDF/semantic technologies, such as RDF/RDFS, OWL, and SPARQL. Working knowledge of, or ability to work across, both LPG and RDF graph models. Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or similar languages. Experience building production data ingestion, transformation, or integration pipelines. Experience with graph databases and/or RDF triple stores. Understanding of entity identity, graph relationships, mappings, provenance, and data quality. Ability to translate conceptual models and mapping specifications into production implementations. Ability to work effectively with evolving requirements and cross-functional technical/domain teams. Other Qualifications (OQs) Hands-on experience with both LPG and RDF/semantic knowledge graphs. Healthcare or life sciences data experience. Familiarity with HL7 FHIR, including concepts such as Coding, CodeableConcept, Reference, and Identifier. Experience with ontology-driven data integration or semantic mapping. Experience with SHACL or other graph/semantic validation approaches. Experience with terminology/concept normalization and canonical concept mapping. Familiarity with clinical terminologies such as SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD, or UMLS. Cloud and CI/CD experience. What Sets You Apart? Hands-on experience with both LPG and RDF/semantic knowledge graphs. Healthcare or life sciences data experience with familiarity with HL7 FHIR and clinical terminologies (SNOMED CT, LOINC, RxNorm, ICD, or UMLS). Experience with ontology-driven data integration, semantic mapping, and SHACL/semantic validation approaches. Cloud and CI/CD engineering experience in production environment. What’s In It For YOU At Quantiphi? Make an impact at one of the world’s fastest-growing AI-first digital engineering companies. Upskill and discover your potential as you solve complex challenges in cutting-edge areas of technology alongside passionate, talented colleagues. Work where innovation happens - work with disruptive innovators in a research-focused organization with 60+ patents filed across various disciplines. Stay ahead of the curve, immerse yourself in breakthrough AI, ML, data, and cloud technologies and gain exposure working with Fortune 1000 companies. If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us! description: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Tech Lead for the Frontend Platform Team provides technical leadership for Xsolla’s core platform responsible for powering all user-facing experiences. This role combines deep engineering expertise with people leadership, guiding a team of approximately eight developers. The Tech Lead shapes the platform’s architecture, improves developer workflows, and ensures high-quality, scalable solutions that support storefronts, widgets, and other monetization-focused experiences used across the Xsolla ecosystem. This position requires strong frontend and platform-level experience, the ability to lead complex technical initiatives, and the capability to support predictable, reliable delivery. ABOUT US Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. From indie to AAA, companies partner with Xsolla to help them fund, distribute, market, and monetize their games. Grounded in the belief in the future of video games, Xsolla is resolute in the mission to bring opportunities together, and continually make new resources available to creators. Headquartered and incorporated in Los Angeles, California, Xsolla operates as the merchant of record and has helped over 1,500+ game developers to reach more players and grow their businesses around the world. With more paths to profits and ways to win, developers have all the things needed to enjoy the game. For more information, visit xsolla.com. Responsibilities: Provide technical leadership for the Xsolla frontend platform, defining architecture, coding standards, and long-term technical direction. Coach, mentor, and manage a team of ~8 developers, supporting professional growth and maintaining a strong engineering culture. Partner closely with the other Tech Leads working on the same platform to ensure architectural alignment, consistent standards, and unified decision-making. Oversee planning and execution of platform features and improvements, ensuring smooth delivery and high-quality outcomes. Drive modernization, refactoring, and performance enhancements to keep the platform scalable, maintainable, and aligned with product goals. Establish and enforce engineering best practices across coding, documentation, testing, and review processes. Collaborate with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and platform teams to deliver cohesive partner-facing experiences. Ensure strong automated test coverage and reliable CI/CD workflows that reduce manual effort and improve delivery predictability. Leverage automation and AI-assisted tooling to accelerate development, improve consistency, and increase developer velocity. Own operational excellence, including incident response, root-cause analysis, and long-term reliability improvements. Advocate for scalability, performance, security, and observability across the platform’s architecture and tooling. Identify technical risks, estimate complexity, and communicate trade-offs to leadership and stakeholders. Foster alignment with other engineering teams on shared services, APIs, rendering pipelines, and platform interfaces. Qualifications & Skills: 8+ years of software development experience with strong expertise in modern frontend engineering at scale. At least 3 years in a similar tech lead role. Deep hands-on knowledge of React including component architecture, SSR patterns, RSC, and complex UI data flows. Proficiency with and MongoDB for server-side functionality. Strong understanding of modern styling systems and theming approaches (vanilla-extract, styled-components, design tokens). Solid TypeScript practices, including strict typing, shared contracts, and schema validation (Zod or equivalent). Experience with Module Federation Good understanding of bundling and compilation, experience with webpack/rollup/vite/esbuild. Experience with automated testing frameworks (Vitest/Jest) and end-to-end testing (Playwright/Cypress). Good understanding of backend integration patterns (REST, GraphQL, RPC-style APIs). Experience with CI/CD workflows (GitLab CI or similar), private registries, and secure artifact handling. Proven ability to lead engineers, own architectural decisions, and manage delivery for complex platform projects. Nice to Have: Experience building platforms or tooling used across multiple frontend teams (design systems, template engines, configuration frameworks). Experience with react-native/mobile experience Knowledge of performance optimization strategies for client-side and server-side rendering. Understanding of accessibility, internationalization, and semantic UI design best practices. Experience developing SDKs, CLI tools, or developer-facing automation. Familiarity with event-driven UI flows, real-time interfaces, or edge-rendering strategies. Background improving developer platforms, observability stacks, or performance monitoring systems. Comfort with UI-as-data approaches and leveraging AI-assisted/no-code tooling to accelerate feature delivery. Benefits:We are passionate about fostering a supportive environment for our team, so we prioritize the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of our employees and their families through a comprehensive Benefits Program. This includes medical, dental, and vision, PTO, and a personalized career roadmap for each employee. By investing in professional development through training and educational opportunities, we ensure that our team thrives both personally and professionally. Together, we’re not just building a business; we’re cultivating a community that values creativity, collaboration, and the transformative power of play. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement: Xsolla is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with the Fair Chance Act. Criminal History Consideration: For the Tech Lead - Frontend Platform Team, we will conduct a background check that may include the following: Criminal history check Employment verification Education verification Relevance to Job Responsibilities: The background check is relevant to this position because of the following role responsibilities: Accessing confidential company data Ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements Handling sensitive financial information/managing budgets/accessing funds Rights Under the Fair Chance Act: Applicants are encouraged to inquire about their rights under the Fair Chance Act. If you have questions regarding our hiring practices, please contact . Originally posted on Himalayas
