description: At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions. Our Values: We Seek A Better Way: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward. We Make It Happen: We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way. We Are Stronger Together: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team. We Care Deeply: We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another. The Position: The Market Access Manager is responsible for the operational infrastructure that enables successful Market Access execution across Veracyte’s diagnostic testing portfolio, including payer credentialing and enrollment, state Medicaid participation, contract implementation, and the system of record for all Market Access agreements and documentation. Reporting to the Director, Market Access & Payer Relations, this individual will partner closely with Market Access, Reimbursement Operations (RCM), external consultants, Client Services, Finance, Legal, Compliance, Regulatory, and Commercial Operations teams to ensure payer contracting and coverage strategies are translated into accurate operational execution. The ideal candidate combines deep knowledge of healthcare reimbursement operations with a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and a passion for improving patient access to innovative diagnostic testing. Key responsibilities: Lead all payer credentialing, re-credentialing, enrollment, and network participation activities across commercial payers, Medicare contractors, all state Medicaid programs and their associated managed care plans, laboratory benefit managers, and other reimbursement stakeholders. Own the end-to-end lifecycle, including initial applications, revalidation, roster and demographic updates, and ongoing maintenance requirements. Manage state-specific Medicaid enrollment requirements, including out-of-state laboratory enrollment where permitted, documentation and attestations, application fees, risk-level screening obligations such as fingerprinting and site visits, and subsequent contracting with Medicaid managed care plans once state enrollment is active. Manage federal government documentation, including SAM ID and associated opportunities, Federal Supply Schedule changes, FSS applications, and documents related to SBA plans, within required federal timelines. Coordinate ownership, control, and managing employee disclosures required by payer and government enrollment applications, working with Legal, Human Resources, Compliance, and executive leadership to gather and safeguard sensitive information. Maintain accurate laboratory, facility, and organizational records across payer systems and enrollment platforms, including NPPES and PECOS demographic data, NPI and taxonomy assignments, PTAN alignment, W-9 and remittance addresses, and payer directory listings. Partner with Regulatory and Quality to ensure CLIA certification and state clinical laboratory licenses and permits remain current, and align enrollment activities with state licensure prerequisites. Own the contract lifecycle after execution, including effective and termination dates, renewal and notice windows, amendments, and escalation of approaching deadlines to the contracting leads. Establish and maintain the system of record for market access documentation, including executed agreements and amendments, payer medical policies and coverage determinations, payer correspondence, and supporting evidence and dossier materials. Maintain version control, access permissions, and retention standards across document management, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), and Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms. Collaborate with Reimbursement Operations (RCM) teams to identify and resolve enrollment-related claim issues, reimbursement delays, and payer operational challenges, including those involving payer portals such as Availity. Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, process documentation, and operational controls related to enrollment, payer setup, contract administration, and reimbursement operations. Support related payer audits, credentialing reviews, and compliance requests. Select, implement, and administer enrollment tracking and contract repository systems, and manage credentialing vendors, external consultants, and third-party partners. Develop dashboards, reporting, and key performance indicators that measure operational performance, including enrollment cycle time by payer type, percentage of target Medicaid lives with active enrollment, on-time revalidation rate, denial dollars attributable to enrollment or configuration defects, and contract record completeness. Evaluate current workflows, identify opportunities for operational efficiencies, and execute process improvements through the effective use of automation and artificial intelligence (AI) tools. Manage group inboxes for payer correspondence and contracting communications. Who You Are: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. A minimum of 6 – 7 years of experience in healthcare reimbursement operations, payer credentialing, provider enrollment, managed care operations, revenue cycle, market access operations, or a related function. Demonstrated experience managing payer enrollment across both commercial and government payers, including hands-on multi-state Medicaid enrollment and revalidation. Working knowledge of enrollment systems and requirements relevant to facility and laboratory entities, including NPPES, PECOS, state Medicaid provider portals, and enrollment tracking platforms. Demonstrated ownership of a recurring compliance calendar such as revalidation, recredentialing, licensure renewal, or contract renewal, with a track record of preventing lapses. Experience administering contracts, fee schedules, or reimbursement documentation as a system of record, including version control and access management. Strong project management skills, including experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives involving reimbursement, billing, legal, compliance, finance, and commercial teams while managing multiple priorities, deadlines, and stakeholders. Experience developing and maintaining operational documentation, workflows, and standard operating procedures. Ability to manage sensitive personal and corporate information, including ownership and control disclosures, with a high degree of professionalism, accuracy, and confidentiality. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting molecular diagnostics, genomic testing, laboratory developed tests (LDTs), precision medicine, oncology diagnostics, or other specialty diagnostic products. Experience enrolling an out-of-state laboratory in state Medicaid programs and navigating state-specific restrictions on out-of-state laboratory participation. Experience with Medicaid managed care plan contracting and roster processes as distinct from state fee-for-service enrollment. Experience with credentialing and contracting in VA and DoD facilities. Experience implementing or administering an enrollment tracking platform or contract lifecycle management system. Certified Provider Credentialing Specialist (CPCS) or similar credentialing certification. Familiarity with Medicare coverage, commercial payer operations, laboratory benefit managers, and diagnostic reimbursement pathways. Experience working with healthcare compliance, audit readiness, and credentialing governance processes. #LI-Hybrid The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to years of experience, skillset, geographic location, industry, education, etc. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, and are committed to fostering an inclusive workforce, where diverse backgrounds are represented, engaged, and empowered to drive innovative ideas and decisions. We are thrilled to be recognized as a 2024 Certified™ Great Place to Work® in both the US and Israel - a testament to our dynamic, inclusive, and inspiring workplace where passion meets purpose. About Veracyte Veracyte (Nasdaq: VCYT) is a global diagnostics company whose vision is to transform cancer care for patients all over the world. We empower clinicians with the high-value insights they need to guide and assure patients at pivotal moments in the race to diagnose and treat cancer. Our Veracyte Diagnostics Platform delivers high-performing cancer tests that are fueled by broad genomic and clinical data, deep bioinformatic and AI capabilities, and a powerful evidence-generation engine, which ultimately drives durable reimbursement and guideline inclusion for our tests, along with new insights to support continued innovation and pipeline development. A key focus will be supporting the preparation of our quarterly and annual external financial statements and disclosures. The role also supports technical accounting and SOX compliance and owns our global financial consolidation. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. YOUR IMPACT Lead AI automation and adoption across accounting and reporting processes: identify high-volume manual work, automate it with AI tools and agents (such as reconciliations, flux analysis, data aggregation, disclosure tie-outs, and first drafts of memos) with appropriate review over AI-generated output, and help the Accounting team adopt these practices. Build, document, and maintain AI-enabled workflows and reporting automation, including in Pigment and NetSuite, and track the time saved and quality improvements they deliver. Support the external reporting team in preparing quarterly and annual financial statements and footnote disclosures, including populating and tying out financial statement tables, maintaining supporting schedules, and coordinating inputs from Accounting, FP&A, and other teams. Prepare supporting analyses for external reporting, such as flux and variance explanations, key metric reconciliations, and disclosure checklists, ensuring internally reported figures reconcile to externally reported results. Support technical accounting by researching accounting questions, preparing recurring memos and analyses (such as capitalized software and impairment assessments), supporting updates to the accounting policy library, and assessing the reporting impact of new accounting standards. Support SOX compliance, including the design, documentation, operation, and remediation of internal controls over financial reporting, partnering with Internal Controls and process owners. Perform independent reviews of financial reporting schedules, disclosures, and reporting packages to maintain appropriate segregation of duties. Lead the monthly, quarterly, and annual global consolidation process across a multinational, multicurrency entity structure, including intercompany eliminations and foreign currency translation. Own lease accounting under ASC 842. Support the accounting integration and system migration of acquired entities. Support debt covenant compliance reporting and coordinate with internal and external auditors on reporting and control requests. Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness. WHO YOU ARE A hands-on, daily user of AI tools such as Gemini, Claude, or ChatGPT, with concrete examples of work you have automated or redesigned with them. Experience building your own AI workflows or agents, for example with Claude Code or Codex, to automate recurring work such as intercompany eliminations, consolidation tie-outs or disclosure checklists is a strong plus. SEC reporting experience, including preparing or supporting quarterly and annual financial statements and footnote disclosures for a public company. Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA preferred 6+ years of progressive accounting experience, with a combination of Big 4 public accounting and public company industry experience preferred. Strong U.S. GAAP knowledge, including experience researching and documenting accounting conclusions. Working knowledge of SOX 404 and internal control over financial reporting. Hands-on experience with financial consolidations in a multinational, multicurrency environment. Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP; experience with Pigment or similar tools, disclosure management software (such as Workiva or ActiveDisclosure), or SQL/Python a plus. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and flexibility to work in a fast-growing, exciting, and agile business. We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. Join our team At GoDaddy, we are seeking an exceptional Principal Compliance Engineer - PKI with deep technical expertise to define requirements and guide the evolution of our Certificate Authority (CA) platform. Reporting to GoDaddy's Vice President Engineering Partners, you will translate industry standards into technical requirements, define specifications for compliance automation, and provide technical guidance for next-generation cryptographic systems. This role combines technical leadership with strategic requirements development, focusing on post-quantum cryptography readiness, certificate lifecycle automation, and CA infrastructure resilience. What you'll get to do... Technical Standards & Requirements Leadership Actively participate in standards bodies such as the IETF, representing GoDaddy in working groups for TLS and related SSL standards CA Infrastructure & Systems Requirements Conduct deep-dive technical assessments of CA infrastructure, identifying architectural gaps, security vulnerabilities, and performance bottlenecks Define technical requirements for the evolution of certificate issuance pipelines, HSM integrations, and cryptographic key management systems Specify requirements for automated testing frameworks for compliance validation, including CT log integration, OCSP responder infrastructure, and revocation mechanisms Develop automation scripts for compliance testing and validation processes Define SLIs/SLOs focused on certificate issuance latency, system availability, and compliance metrics Document requirements for infrastructure-as-code solutions for CA deployment, disaster recovery, and high-availability architectures Cryptographic Systems & Innovation Research and define requirements for post-quantum cryptographic algorithms (e.g., ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA) and hybrid certificate chains Develop emerging standards (ACME extensions, certificate transparency v2, delegated credentials) Collaborate with cryptography researchers to evaluate algorithm performance, key sizes, and implementation trade-offs Platform Requirements & Automation Define the technical requirements roadmap for CA platform capabilities including certificate lifecycle automation, API development, and integration frameworks Specify requirements for scalable APIs and automation tools for certificate issuance, renewal, and revocation workflows Document specifications for self-service platforms and tools to reduce manual intervention in certificate operations Develop automated testing scripts and define requirements for continuous compliance monitoring systems with automated remediation capabilities Technical Collaboration & Documentation Partner with security engineering teams on threat modeling, secure coding practices, and vulnerability management Lead architecture reviews and technical design sessions with cross-functional engineering teams, providing requirements and guidance Establish technical documentation standards and compliance engineering requirements for CA-related systems Mentor cryptography, or security infrastructure with proven technical leadership and strong technical background in languages such as Go, Python, Java, or C++ Deep expertise in PKI architecture including X.509 certificate structures, ASN.1 encoding, certificate chain validation, HSM operations, and cryptographic primitives Proven experience translating CA/Browser Forum Baseline Requirements into technical specifications, including controls for key generation, certificate issuance, and audit logging Systems engineering background with experience in distributed systems, API design, database architecture, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) Strong ability to define requirements for PKI protocols (ACME, Certificate Transparency, OCSP/CRL) and translate compliance requirements into description: At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions. Our Values: We Seek A Better Way: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward. We Make It Happen: We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way. We Are Stronger Together: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team. We Care Deeply: We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another. The Position: The Senior Genomics Specialist role is responsible for growing and developing the Decipher testing business in a defined geography. This role will call on Urologists and Radiation Oncologists in Academic, Community and LUGPA accounts, leveraging account-specific business plans to define opportunities, and establishing plans to deepen and expand the credibility of Decipher. Successful Senior Genomic Specialists work in close collaboration with Medical Science Liaisons, Market Access, Marketing, Customer Service, and Legal. The successful candidate will utilize cross-functional support to generate sales through strategic and tactical activities, coordinate appropriate customer support, and follow-through to ensure customer satisfaction and repeat usage of our flagship product Decipher. Ideal candidates will possess a depth of knowledge in the urology and radiation oncology market, and functional knowledge in the clinical/scientific aspects of prostate cancer diagnosis and treatment. This ideal candidate would be located in Connecticut. Responsibilities include: Effectively building a short/medium/long term sales pipeline and manage the necessary levels of sales leads, prospects and opportunities Building a comprehensive knowledge of customers and prospects including the overall market, customer needs, personnel and responsibilities, budgeting, knowing their funding processes and the competition Identifying, developing, and maintaining high-value relationships with KOLs, urologist’s, radiation oncologists, LUGPAs, hospitals, and academic centers Establishing effective territory strategies which further Decipher’s goals in select targeted key accounts by developing account-specific business plans which prioritize and leverage internal resources Demonstrating knowledge of, access to, and the ability to influence all key stakeholders in targeted accounts Attending identified relevant national/regional/local education meetings and conferences, maximizing opportunities at these events to deepen and expand the credibility of Decipher tests Delivering compelling sales presentations: close initial business, follow-up and identify repeat business while building a network of referrals Satisfying all product and technology training requirements as established by management Building a comprehensive knowledge of customers and prospects including the overall market, customer needs, personnel and responsibilities, budgeting Coordinating and communicating sales activities and strategies to management while defining resource requirements Developing and maintaining all account/contact details within Customer Relationship Management database (SFDC) Utilizing sales tracking tools to effectively monitor incoming orders and commercial reimbursement Providing regular and accurate sales forecast updates Complying with all Federal and State laws, regulations and policies Who You Are Bachelor’s degree (Science/Marketing preferred; MS/MBA or higher a plus). Strong technical background in molecular biology, genomics, urology preferred 5+ years of successful sales or account management experience in molecular diagnostics, urology, oncology, biotech, life science or diagnostic sales Cross functional experience in Sales Management, Sales Training, Marketing, etc. is a plus Strong attention to detail and managing projects with minimal direct supervision Well-developed professional and strategic selling skills with a proven ability to grow key accounts by building and leveraging networks Demonstrated ability to work in a team environment, with the goals of bringing the appropriate resources to a specific customer need Demonstrated ability to convert qualified leads into closed sales Excellent listening, time management, organizational and interpersonal skills Demonstrated interpersonal skills; effective matrix communication and leadership skills Strategic account management, previous experience in developing & implementing attainable account-specific business plans is required Experience with effective utilization of salesforce.com or similar CRM database a plus Experience working within a multi-state region and the ability to travel 50% of the time is a must For candidates working remote (US), the range is $128,000 - $140,000. The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to years of experience, skillset, geographic location, industry, education, etc. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units. Pay range $128,000—$140,000 USD What We Can Offer You Veracyte is a growing company that offers significant career opportunities if you are curious, driven, patient-oriented and aspire to help us build a great company. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, and are committed to fostering an inclusive workforce, where diverse backgrounds are represented, engaged, and empowered to drive innovative ideas and decisions. We are thrilled to be recognized as a 2024 Certified™ Great Place to Work® in both the US and Israel - a testament to our dynamic, inclusive, and inspiring workplace where passion meets purpose. About Veracyte Veracyte (Nasdaq: VCYT) is a global diagnostics company whose vision is to transform cancer care for patients all over the world. We empower clinicians with the high-value insights they need to guide and assure patients at pivotal moments in the race to diagnose and treat cancer. Our Veracyte Diagnostics Platform delivers high-performing cancer tests that are fueled by broad genomic and clinical data, deep bioinformatic and AI capabilities, and a powerful evidence-generation engine, which ultimately drives durable reimbursement and guideline inclusion for our tests, along with new insights to support continued innovation and pipeline development. For more information, please visit www.veracyte.com or follow us on LinkedIn or X (Twitter). Veracyte, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status or disability status. Veracyte participates in E-Verify in the United States.
